# 📜 Plankrun

> **Entity**: Plankrun_journal

The first ever Mouse Hunter; Plankrun was commissioned by the King to investigate the strange behaviors of the Mice appearing in the region of Gnawnia. His fate is, as of yet, unknown. However, pages torn from his journal have been found across the region, detailing his brave escapades. The page read by the Scribe Mouse mentions that he was known as Sir Plankrun.

## Inventions

- Traps
Ambush
- Cheese
Susheese
Combat
Glutter
Rumble
- Other
Passageway to Acolyte Realm

## Belongings

- Torn Pages of Plankrun's Journal


---

# 📜 Torn Pages of Plankrun's Journal

> **Entity**: Plankrun_journal

> "Journal" redirects here. For other uses, see Hunter's Journal.

The Torn Pages of Plankrun’s Journal are obtained as loot from certain breeds of mice. They are placed in the Plankrun Inventory tab of a hunter's inventory. As of now, the Pages have no known use, outside of being collector's items.

The pages are found grouped together as two sides of a single page. For example, if a hunter captures a mouse carrying the Dojo pages, the hunter will have both sides of that page. Similarly, covers include both the inside and outside of the respective cover.

## Description

During your travels you may find pages from the fabled MouseHunter Plankrun. The stories of this first-ever MouseHunter have been whispered over campfires throughout the years. Unfortunately, all that is known about the fate of this hunter is what can be deciphered from the Torn Pages of Plankrun's Journal, often found scattered across the Kingdom.

| Abominable Snow mice are far from bashful. They love to play innocent pranks that always seem to involve pelting others with a barrage of snowballs. These mice are occasionally seen wandering down from the Mountains to give hunters a hard time. |  |  |  |
|  | Mouse ID#: 1 |  |  |

## Cheese and Charm Preference

### Cheese

The Abominable Snow Mouse is attracted only to Abominable Asiago Cheese.

### Charm

No Charms are required to attract the Abominable Snow Mouse.

## Power Type Weaknesses

| VeryEffective | Effective | Less Effective |
| --- | --- | --- |
| None | AllexceptDraconic, Parental and Rift | None |

## Locations

Hunters can encounter the Abominable Snow Mouse only in the Mountain location.

## Loot

The Abominable Snow Mouse drops the following loot in the Mountain location:

- Divine Orb
- Super Power Charm
- Ancient Relic

## History and Trivia

- The name and visual appearance of the Abominable Snow Mouse are based on common incarnations of the Abominable Snowman legend.
- 11 December 2008: The Abominable Snow Mouse was released.
- Christmas 2008: The Mountain became the sole habitat of the Abominable Snow Mouse.
- 16 November 2009: The Abominable Snow Mouse was chosen as the first "Monday Mystery Mouse".
- 25 January 2011: The Abominable Snow Mouse began to drop Divine Orbs as loot.
- 25 June 2013: The Abominable Snow Mouse gained a vulnerability to Law power type traps, with the release of Varmint Valley.
- 25 March 2014: The Abominable Snow Mouse gained a vulnerability to Rift power type traps, with the introduction of the Rift Plane.
- 7 November 2017: The Abominable Snow Mouse image was updated and began to drop Super Power Charms as loot. Gold and points were increased from 1,750 each, to 5,000 each.
- 17 October 2018: The Abominable Snow Mouse changed mouse groups from Indigenous Mice to Mountain Mice.

## Preferred Cheese

The Absolute Acolyte Mouse has been found to be especially attracted to Runic String Cheese, to the point that any other kind of cheese will simply not suffice.

## Power Type Weaknesses

| VeryEffective | Effective | Less Effective |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rift | None | None |

## Hunting Strategy

Only Rift type traps are very effective against Absolute Acolyte Mouse, all other power types are ineffective.

Absolute Acolyte Mouse can only be attracted upon fully charging the Timesplit Obelisk in the Acolyte Chamber and can only be caught after fully draining the Acolyte’s sand.

Completing the Frozen Alcove will prevent the Absolute Acolyte from pillaging the Hunter's trap and it will add additional loot to the Absolute Acolyte when caught.

## History and Trivia

- 31 May 2017: The Absolute Acolyte Mouse was introduced as part of the Bristle Woods Rift release.

Had it not been for Plankrun’s heroic efforts, the small village of Gnawnia may never have become the prosperous town it is today. ## Power Type Weaknesses

| VeryEffective | Effective | Less Effective |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Forgotten | None | ShadowArcane |

## Locations

Hunters can encounter the Acolyte Mouse only in the Acolyte Realm location.

## Loot

The Acolyte Mouse drops the following loot in the Acolyte Realm location:

- Mysterious Box
- Ancient Relic

## History and Trivia

- The Acolyte Mouse was first discovered after a glitch occurred while the developers were clearing out the account of a known scammer.

- On the Dojo header image, the two mice standing guard are Acolyte Mice.

- Acolyte Mice caught before 25 March 2009 did not drop Mysterious Boxes.

- On 30 September 2009, the Acolyte Mouse began to drop Frozen Scrolls alongside Mysterious Boxes. Hunters with previously unopened Mysterious Boxes were credited a Frozen Scroll, while those with a Frozen Scroll were given another Mysterious Box.

- In MouseHunt 3.0, the Acolyte Mouse no longer drops a Frozen Scroll. Instead the Mysterious Box now always gives a Frozen Scroll plus one random item.

- The Acolyte Mouse began dropping Ancient Relics as loot on 29 August 2012.

This malevolent marauder is undefeated in hand-to-hook combat thanks to his massive, untamed beard making him an impossible target. His opponents can never tell where the beard ends and the Admiral begins. It's so thick that swords get stuck in it and shots get completely absorbed. Legend has it that his mighty beard has even survived being shot with a cannonball!<br>There is only one sky dweller brave enough to face the Admiral head-on and capable enough to come out of it alive and intact, his arch-nemesis: Ronza! Unfortunately for them, she has consistently managed to elude, confuse, defeat, and humiliate Cloudbeard and his cronies at every turn. The Artillery Commander Mouse can be encountered and attracted in the Artillery Commander's Tent, but is immune to capture until five Theurgy Warden Mice have been caught. Using an Ultimate Charm will override this immunity.

- 14 April 2011: The Black Widow Mouse began dropping a bonus Black Widow Egg as loot during the Spring Egg Hunt 2011 event.
- 29 August 2012: The Black Widow Mouse began dropping the Ancient Relic as loot.
- 25 June 2013: The Black Widow Mouse gained a vulnerability to Law power type traps, with the release of Varmint Valley.
- 19 September 2013: As part of the Gnawnia mice population shift, the Black Widow Mouse was removed from the Meadow and Town of Gnawnia locations.
- 25 March 2014: The Black Widow Mouse gained a vulnerability to Rift power type traps, with the introduction of the Rift Plane.

# 🐭 Bounty Hunter Mouse

> **Entity**: Mouse_lore

| Bounty Hunter Mouse |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mouse Group: Wild Bunch (Misc) |  |  |  |
| Mouse Statistics |  |  |  |
| Points: | 6,000 | Gold: | 4,000 |
| Location & Attraction Info |  |  |  |
| Required Power Types: | Law | Other Requirements: |  |
| Cheese: | No Preference | Charm: |  |
| Locations: | Claw Shot City | Loot: | Sealed Wanted PosterSheriff's Badge Charm |
| Links |  |  |  |
| Larry's Loot Lexicon: | MouseHunt Info Page | Image: | Image Link |
| This lonesome vigilante creates quite the scene when he enters town. His appearance often signals trouble and a whole heap of it. Shopkeepers often bar their doors and windows while he wanders the streets, as his reckless style tends to leave smoking ruins wherever he passes. Extremely dangerous and self-sufficient, it is said that this mouse is known to honour just one authority figure: the Sheriff.<br>Capturing this mouse will earn you the Sealed Wanted Poster he's carrying. Track down the gang and earn a bounty for it! The Bounty Hunter Mouse won't stick around if you're already chasing down a bounty.<br>This mouse will bend to the authority of the local Sheriff. Hunters with a Sheriff's Badge Charm equipped will instantly catch the Bounty Hunter Mouse and collect two Sealed Wanted Posters from him. Easier than licking dust off of a barn! |  |  |  |
|  | Mouse ID#: 467 |  |  |

## Hunting Strategy

Law type traps such as S.L.A.C. are very effective against the Bounty Hunter Mouse.
The Bounty Hunter Mouse can only be encountered if the Hunter is not doing a Wanted Poster.
The Bounty Hunter Mouse is guaranteed to drop a Sealed Wanted Poster upon capture.
Hunters with a Sheriff's Badge Charm equipped are guaranteed to catch the next Bounty Hunter Mouse they encounter and loot 2 Sealed Wanted Posters, even without using a Law trap. The mouse attraction rate remains the same.

If the Hunter already has the maximum limit of 6 Sealed Wanted Poster, the Bounty Hunter Mouse will not drop one, with the following message appearing in the Hunter's Journal:

> The Bounty Hunter Mouse didn't leave me a Sealed Wanted Poster as I have the maximum allowed by the Marshall of Varmint Valley.

## History and Trivia

- 25 June 2013: The Bounty Hunter Mouse was released as part of the Claw Shot City content.
- 14 June 2022: Sealed Wanted Posters are now a guaranteed loot drop and the Bounty Hunter Mouse can now be encountered even when Hunters have Sealed Wanted Posters in their inventory. The message that used to be displayed in the Hunter's Journal upon capturing the Bounty Hunter Mouse was removed:

> I've caught a Bounty Hunter! He was carrying a Sealed Wanted Poster, which are special bounties issued from the Marshall of Varmint Valley! I should unfurl the Wanted Poster, bring a friend along as my Deputy, and start hunting down one of the Wild Bunch mouse gangs!
While I'm actively hunting down a Wild Bunch gang, the Bounty Hunter Mouse will avoid my trap until he can find a new poster for me.

## History and Trivia

- The nickname for the Burglar Mouse did indeed come from a certain notorious scammer. He was believed to be the first to try to repeatedly get honest players to part with their SUPER|brie+ for free on the forums.
- The Burglar Mouse was originally also available in the Town of Gnawnia, as well as several other locations.
- 23 May 2008: The Burglar Mouse is released
- 8 June 2010: The Burglar Mouse began to drop Gilded Cheese as loot with the release of MouseHunt version 3.0.
- 25 January 2011: The Burglar Mouse began to drop Flawless Orbs as loot.
- 19 April 2011: The Burglar Mouse dropped the Antique Scalloped Pink Egg as loot in the Bazaar as part of the Spring Egg Hunt 2011 event.
- 14 April 2011: The Burglar Mouse began dropping a bonus Burglar Egg as loot as part of the annual Spring Egg Hunt.
- 25 June 2013: The Burglar Mouse gained a vulnerability to Law power type traps, with the release of Varmint Valley.
- 25 March 2014: The Burglar Mouse gained a vulnerability to Rift power type traps with the introduction of the Rift Plane.
- 14 October 2014: The Burglar Mouse was given new art. The costumed version appeared during the Halloween 2014 event and the new uncostumed version appeared when the event ended on 4 November 2014.

# 🐭 Caravan Guard Mouse

> **Entity**: Mouse_lore

The Caravan Guard Mouse is a breed of mouse found in the Fiery Warpath location, only where there are more than 10 mice left to defeat in Wave One, more than 18 mice left in Wave Two, or more than 26 mice left in Wave Three.

Caravan Guard mice are not known to drop any loot.

| Caravan Guard Mouse |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mouse Group: The Marching Flame (Support) |  |  |  |
| Mouse Statistics |  |  |  |
| Points: | 900 | Gold: | 900 |
| Location & Attraction Info |  |  |  |
| Required Power Types: | Physical, Tactical, Hydro | Other Requirements: | Wave 1,2 or 3 |
| Cheese: | No Preference | Charm: | None |
| Locations: | Fiery Warpath | Loot: | None |
| Links |  |  |  |
| Larry's Loot Lexicon: | MouseHunt Info Page | Image: | Image Link |
| This mouse acts as the veins of the war - carrying the lifeblood of weapons, armor, water, and food to the battle front. An army is nothing without supplies. Failing to capture a Caravan Guard will undoubtedly strengthen the Marching Flame's forces. |  |  |  |
|  | Mouse ID#: 316 |  |  |

## Preferred Cheese

Caravan Guard mice have no specific preference for any kind of cheese. In fact, they are known to have an aversion to SUPER|brie+ cheese and are known to avoid traps baited with them.

## Hunting Strategy

None of the weapon types are very effective or effective against Caravan Guard mice. Physical, Hydro, and Tactical traps are less effective, and the rest are ineffective.

When a hunter fails to capture a Caravan Guard Mouse, one of the following messages will appear on the Hunter's Journal:

> Strength in numbers! After I failed to catch a Caravan Guard Mouse, members of my hunting party were able to prevent the mouse reinforcements from arriving!

Or

> Failing to capture a Caravan Guard Mouse allowed reinforcements to arrive!
More mice have been added to the wave!

When failing to catch a Caravan Guard Mouse, additional mice will be added to the current wave. If a hunter has friends currently in the Sandtail Desert region, there is a chance that additional mice will not be added. A minimum of one friend is needed in helping to prevent reinforcements from arriving. However, no matter how many friends a hunter has in this region, it is not a 100% guarantee that reinforcements will be prevented.

Since failure to catch a Caravan Guard mouse carries a risk of increasing the number of mice remaining to be defeated, hunters wishing to avoid this risk are advised to use SUPER|brie+ cheese to minimize the possibility of encountering this mouse. Additionally, fewer Caravan Guard mice are attracted when any Warpath charm is armed (Warpath Archer, Warpath Soldier, Warpath Scout, Warpath Cavalry, Warpath Mage, or the super variants of these charms). In particular, arming a Warpath Mage Charm or Warpath Cavalry Charm in Wave 1 can be an effective way to adjust the population without having any charms consumed.

## History and Trivia

- Caravan Guard Mice were introduced on 22 March 2011 with the release of the Sandtail Desert region.

The Chess Master is a breed of mouse found in the Zugzwang's Tower. They are known to drop Ancient Relic, Master Bindings and occasionally, Zugzwang's Left Sock, as loot. Hunters are transported to the Seasonal Garden upon catching the Chess Master.

| Chess Master |  |  |  |

| Mouse Group: Wizard's Pieces (Misc) |  |  |  |

| Atop the tall tower, in the midst of an isle of madness, sits the maddest mouse of them all: the Chess Master. The Seasonal Garden and the Tower answer to his whims, changing with his mercurial moods. Behind his glowing white eyes lies the mind which produced the rage of the Technic King, and the cold brutality of the Mystic Queen. The Chess Master has the potential to create anything- but he is more likely to destroy everything. |  |  |  |
|  | Mouse ID#: 278 |  |  |

## Preferred Cheese

The Chess Master is only attracted to Checkmate Cheese.

## Hunting Strategy

The Chess Master can be attracted using Checkmate Cheese once the Hunter catches either a Mystic King or a Technic King and stays in the tower (by either using Checkmate Cheese or Stalemate Charm).

Tactical traps are very effective against the Chess Master, while all others are ineffective.

Catching the Chess Master will cause the Hunter to be moved to the Seasonal Garden unless Stalemate Charm is also armed. If the Hunter manages to stay in Zugzwang's Tower after catching the Chess Master (by using Stalemate Charm), they can attempt to catch more mice, including the Chess Master itself.

Catching a Chess Master with a Uncharged Scholar Charm armed will add a Scholar Charm to the Hunter's inventory. This charm can be used to attract Zurreal the Eternal in Crystal Library.

## History and Trivia

- 26 August 2010: The Chess Master was released as part of the Zugzwang's Tower.
- The Chess Master is pictured wearing one sock on the right foot; its mate is Zugzwang's Left Sock dropped as loot.
- 29 August 2012: The Chess Master began dropping Ancient Relic as loot.

# 🐭 Crimson Commander Mouse

> **Entity**: Mouse_lore

The Crimson Commander Mouse is a breed of mouse found in the Fiery Warpath location during Wave One, Wave Two and Wave Three. They are not known to drop any loot.

| Crimson Commander Mouse |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mouse Group: The Marching Flame (Support) |  |  |  |
| Mouse Statistics |  |  |  |
| Points: | 10,000 | Gold: | 1,000 |
| Location & Attraction Info |  |  |  |
| Required Power Types: | ArcaneDraconicHydroPhysicalTactical | Other Requirements: | Wave 1,2 or 3 |
| Cheese: | SUPER&#124;brie+ | Charm: | None |
| Locations: | Fiery Warpath | Loot: | None |
| Links |  |  |  |
| Larry's Loot Lexicon: | MouseHunt Info Page | Image: | Image Link |
| The Crimson Commander carries its Warmonger's orders into battle. The strategy of the entire war is entrusted to these mice. Defeating them could turn the tide of the battle. |  |  |  |
|  | Mouse ID#: 310 |  |  |

## Preferred Cheese

Crimson Commander mice have been found to be especially attracted to SUPER|brie+ cheese.

## Special Effect

Upon capturing a Crimson Commander Mouse, the following message will be displayed on the Hunter's Journal:
By capturing a Crimson Commander Mouse I demoralized the remaining mice in this wave!
My current streak was x.
x of each mouse have retreated!

## Hunting Strategy

Catching a Crimson Commander Mouse, particularly during a streak of unbroken catches of a specific Marching Flame class or unit (Archer, Scout, Warrior, Cavalry, Mage or Artillery), will help to reduce the remaining quantities of mice that require defeating in that current Wave.
Hunters have the option of arming Warpath Commander's Charms or Super Warpath Commander's Charms to help increase the likelihood of encountering a Crimson Commander Mouse.

During Wave One, Crimson Commander Mice retreat when there are less than 11 mice remaining in the troops to be defeated.
During Wave Two, Crimson Commander Mice retreat when there are less than 19 mice remaining in the troops to be defeated.
During Wave Three, Crimson Commander Mice retreat when there are less than 27 mice remaining in the troops to be defeated.

## Event Participation

- The Crimson Commander Mouse drops the Warpath Egg during the annual Spring Egg Hunt.

## History and Trivia

- Crimson Commander Mice were introduced on 22 March 2011 with the release of the Sandtail Desert region.
- During the Spring Egg Hunt 2011, Crimson Commander Mice began dropping a bonus Warpath Egg as loot for hunters who had obtained the Rocket Rabbit Mallet. They dropped the same loot the following year during the Spring Egg Hunt 2012 event for hunters who had obtained the Eggscavator.

# 🐭 Crown Collector Mouse

> **Entity**: Mouse_lore

| Crown Collector Mouse |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mouse Group: Indigenous Mice (Rare Rodent) |  |  |  |
| Mouse Statistics |  |  |  |
| Points: | 1,000 | Gold: | 1,000 |
| Location & Attraction Info |  |  |  |
| Required Power Types: | All Power Types except Parental | Other Requirements: | Attraction Rate is affected by thenumber of silver and gold Crownsa Hunter has obtained. |
| Cheese: | SUPER&#124;brie+ | Charm: | None |
| Locations: | BazaarCrystal LibraryKing's ArmsS.S. Huntington IV | Loot: | None |
| Links |  |  |  |
| Larry's Loot Lexicon: | MouseHunt Info Page | Image: | Image Link |
| Crown Collector mice were renowned for their rarity and difficulty to catch. Even such powerful mice as the Dojo Sensei came to them for advice on how to properly pillage pesky Hunters!<br>Over time, these mice began to charge a fee for their advice... and their only fee was the crowns that the King awarded to his most elite Hunters. Now obsessed with gaining more and more crowns, these mice most often visit the traps of hunters who have earned several crowns themselves. |  |  |  |
|  | Mouse ID#: 350 |  |  |

## Cheese and Charm Preference

### Cheese

The Crown Collector Mouse has a strong attraction for SUPER|brie+ but can also be attracted using Standard Cheese.

In the Bazaar location, the Crown Collector Mouse can also be attracted when hunting with Gilded Cheese.
Aboard the S.S. Huntington IV, the Crown Collector Mouse can also be attracted when hunting with Galleon Gouda.

### Charm

No Charms are required to attract the Crown Collector Mouse.

The Attraction Rate of the Crown Collector Mouse is affected by the number of silver and gold Crowns a Hunter has obtained. As the number of collected crowns increases, the encounter rate for this mouse will improve, though the effect will be small.

## Power Type Effectiveness

| VeryEffective | Effective | Less Effective |
| --- | --- | --- |
| None | All Power Types except Parental | None |

## History and Trivia

- 5 August 2011: The Crown Collector Mouse was painted live during an 'All about the art' Feedback Friday. Ideas and suggestions for how the mouse should look were provided by the audience at the time of painting.
- 12 August 2011: The Crown Collector Mouse was introduced in recognition of the MouseHunt Century Club.
- 25 June 2013: The Crown Collector Mouse gained a vulnerability to Law power type traps with the release of Varmint Valley.
- 25 March 2014: The Crown Collector Mouse gained a vulnerability to Rift power type traps with the introduction of the Rift Plane.
- 06 May 2020: The Crown Collector Mouse was removed from Tournament Hall and added to the King's Arms.

Hunters must arm the Deep Freeze Base, Iceberg Boiler Base, or Ultimate Iceberg Base when catching Icewing and then complete the Hidden Depths in prior to hunt #250 to enter The Deep Lair and encounter the Deep Mouse. The Deep Mouse is a guaranteed catch on hunt 250, but only if attracted to the Hunter's trap. Therefore, it is recommended that Hunters arm SUPER|brie+ for that final hunt.

The quantities of Deep Thought (25,000 points) and Satchel of Gold (10,000 gold) dropped as loot is dependent on how many hunts remain of the allowed 250 when the Hunter catches the Deep Mouse. A successful catch of the Deep Mouse will award 1 each of Deep Thought and Satchel of Gold, with each hunt remaining in the allotted 250 awarding an additional 1 each, up to a maximum of 10 each in total.

## History and Trivia

- 14 June 2012: The Deep Mouse was released.
- 29 August 2012: The Deep Mouse began dropping Ancient Relic as loot.

## Cheese and Charm Preference

### Cheese

The Diamond Mouse can be attracted using Standard Cheese.

In the Town of Gnawnia location, the Diamond Mouse can also be encountered when hunting with Gilded Cheese.
In the Windmill location, the Diamond Mouse will not be encountered when hunting with Grilled Cheese.
In the Mountain location, the Diamond Mouse will not be encountered when hunting with Chedd-Ore Cheese or Abominable Asiago Cheese.
In the Dojo location, the Diamond Mouse can also be encountered when hunting with Maki Cheese.

### Charm

No Charms are required to attract the Diamond Mouse.

Hunters may arm the Prospector's Charm in the Mountain location to improve the attraction rate of the Diamond Mouse, Gold Mouse, and Silvertail Mouse.

## Power Type Weaknesses

| VeryEffective | Effective | Less Effective |
| --- | --- | --- |
| None | AllexceptDraconic, Parental and Rift | None |

## Locations

Hunters can encounter the Diamond Mouse in the following locations:

- Gnawnia:

> Meadow
Town of Gnawnia
Windmill
Harbour
Mountain

- Valour:

> King's Arms
Tournament Hall

- Burroughs:

> Town of Digby

- Furoma:

> Training Grounds
Dojo

## Loot

The Diamond Mouse drops the following loot:

- Gnawnia:

> Meadow - Satchel of Gold (500)
Windmill - Packet of Flour and Simple Orb
Harbour - Simple Orb
Mountain - Simple Orb

- Burroughs:

> Town of Digby - Simple Orb

- Furoma:

> Training Grounds - Simple Orb
Dojo - Simple Orb

The Diamond Mouse is not known to drop any loot in the King's Arms, Tournament Hall, or Town of Gnawnia locations.

## History and Trivia

- 25 January 2011: The Diamond Mouse began to drop Simple Orb as loot.
- 4 April 2012: The Diamond Mouse began dropping a bonus Diamond Egg as loot as part of the Spring Egg Hunt 2012 event.
- 25 June 2013: The Diamond Mouse gained a vulnerability to Law power type traps, with the release of Varmint Valley.
- 25 March 2014: The Raw Diamond Mouse was introduced as the Rift counterpart of the Diamond Mouse.
- 25 March 2014: The Diamond Mouse gained a vulnerability to Rift power type traps, with the introduction of the Rift Plane.
- 2 September 2014: The Diamond Mouse began to drop Packet of Flour at the Windmill.
- 17 October 2018: The Diamond Mouse changed mouse groups from Indigenous Mice to Mountain Mice.
- 5 October 2021: The Gold for Diamond Mouse was increased as part of the Town of Gnawnia and Windmill gameplay updates.

| High above the summit of Dracano circles the terrible Dragon mouse, scourge of the Tribal Isles. To this date, no trap has withstood the Dragon's fiery breath, and all attempts to hunt it have reduced the most advanced traps to smoking debris. Legend has it that the Acolyte Mice held the key to controlling the Dragon, but now that they are trapped in another realm, the Dragon mouse has expanded its territory. The Dragon Mouse is only attracted to Inferno Havarti.

## Hunting Strategy

Draconic is the only power type that is very effective against the Dragon Mouse. All other weapon types are ineffective.

Dragonbane Charm, Super Dragonbane Charm, Extreme Dragonbane Charm, and Ultimate Dragonbane Charm provide a power bonus against the Dragon Mouse.

## History and Trivia

- 29 September 2009: The Dragon Mouse was introduced with the release of the Dracano.
- According to HitGrab developer Jacob Johnson, "The dragon mouse image was created back in May of 2008. The dragon was pretty much just a few sketches until I found the one that I wanted to do, once the dragon was created it stayed as is until it was finally released. We just tailored the story to fit since the original intention didn't work out in the end. Hence why it ended up taking so long to come out." [1]
- The description of the Dragon Mouse has been shortened since its release. The original description was:

> Seen from a great distance, soaring high above the summit of Dracano, the Dragon mouse is terrible to behold. The mice of the Elub, Nerg and Derr have a mutual respect for the Dragon, often traveling through the treacherous Jungle of Dread to make offerings of Inferno cheese to keep the Dragon mouse from ransacking their villages. Lore tells us that the Dragon does have a weakness, but no Trapsmith has succeeded in building a trap that is powerful enough to withstand the might of the Dragon mouse. Their attempts have all resulted in a smoldering pile of debris, as no trap has been capable of withstanding its fiery breath. It has been said that long ago, before their defeat, the Acolyte mice discovered the Dragon Mouse’s true weakness. If it were not for the efforts of Plankrun, the Acolyte mice would have succeeded in their plan to enslave the Dragon mouse as a soldier in their armies. With the Acolyte mice long locked away in another realm, the Dragon mouse, lacking any opposition, has been slowly expanding its territory. Now with its sights set across the Rodentia Ocean at Gnawnia, what MouseHunter will heed the call to stop the Dragon mouse from ravaging the Kingdom?

- 29 August 2012: The Dragon Mouse began dropping Ancient Relic as loot.
- Whenever the Marketplace is disabled, such as when recovering from a server outage, the Dragon Mouse is implicated with this message:

> A recent Dragon attack has left the marketplace slightly singed! We are currently doing maintenance on the marketplace.
Any marketpace items or unclaimed gold will be available when the marketplace returns.
Please check back later.

## History and Trivia

- The Dwarf Mouse is one of the first mice that can be found and is generally the most common mouse encountered after the White, Brown, and Grey mice. In MouseHunt 2.0 when mice were assigned power types, it was usually the first Tactical type mouse encountered by hunters.
- January 2010: The Dwarf Mouse description was briefly changed for the 2010 New Year and references an event that occurred at the 2009 MTV Music Awards.

> Now that he's found all of this colorful loot, the Dwarf Mouse has developed a penchant for interrupting people during acceptance speeches. 2010 is the best New Year's. . . of all time.

- 8 June 2010: After the introduction of MouseHunt 3.0, the Dwarf Mouse was no longer found in the Lagoon and stopped dropping Splintered Wood in the Mountain.
- 30 June 2010: Prior to the introduction of the Windmill, the Dwarf Mouse dropped Plankrun's Gnawnia Notes in the Meadow rather than the Town of Gnawnia.
- 16 April 2011: The Dwarf Mouse began dropping the Antique Blue Argyle Egg as loot in the Town of Digby as part of the Spring Egg Hunt 2011 event.
- 25 June 2013: The Dwarf Mouse gained a vulnerability to Law power type traps, with the release of Varmint Valley.
- 25 March 2014: The Rift Guardian Mouse was introduced as the Rift counterpart of the Dwarf Mouse.
- 25 March 2014: The Dwarf Mouse gained a vulnerability to Rift power type traps, with the introduction of the Rift Plane.
- 2 September 2014: The Dwarf Mouse began dropping Packets of Flour at the Windmill.
- 17 October 2018: The Dwarf Mouse was removed from the Laboratory.

|  | Mouse ID#: 1087 |  |  |

- 30 June 2010: The Flying Mouse was added to the Meadow and Windmill locations.
- 25 June 2013: The Flying Mouse gained a vulnerability to Law power type traps, with the release of Varmint Valley.
- 19 September 2013: The Flying Mouse gained a taste for Brie Cheese and Gouda Cheese during the Gnawnia population shift, although SUPER|brie+ still remains the most effective bait.
- 25 March 2014: The Dream Drifter Mouse was introduced as the Rift counterpart of the Flying Mouse.
- 25 March 2014: The Flying Mouse gained a vulnerability to Rift power type traps, with the introduction of the Rift Plane.
- 2 September 2014: The Flying Mouse began dropping Packet of Flour as loot at the Windmill.
- 5 October 2021: The Gold for Flying Mouse was increased as part of the Town of Gnawnia and Windmill gameplay update.

# 🐭 Force Fighter

> **Entity**: Mouse_lore

During MouseHunt's Fifth Birthday, five new mice decided to form an attack force against Ronza's airship. Known as the Force Fighter Five, each of these mice had their own colored costume, and each dropped loot of multiple Force Fighter Action Figures matching their color. Additionally, the mice could join forces into a larger Super FighterBot MegaSupreme robot, terrorizing the event.

Thankfully, the mice were careless, and also dropped Robot Scraps as loot. A hunter could collect 10 of each color of scrap, as well as buy a Repurposed Robot Head from Ronza, in order to create the Ultra MegaMouser MechaBot Trap. This weapon was the only way to beat the combined Force Fighters, and earn the Crushed Birthday Cake Base as a reward for saving the birthday celebrations.

| Mouse | Collectible | Scrap |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Force Fighter Blue | Force Fighter Blue Action Figure | Blue Leg Robot Scrap |
| Force Fighter Green | Force Fighter Green Action Figure | Green Arm Robot Scrap |
| Force Fighter Pink | Force Fighter Pink Action Figure | Pink Leg Robot Scrap |
| Force Fighter Red | Force Fighter Red Action Figure | Red Chest Robot Scrap |
| Force Fighter Yellow | Force Fighter Yellow Action Figure | Yellow Arm Robot Scrap |

Progress in building the new weapon could be tracked in the Heads-up Display at Ronza's Traveling Shoppe. Upon catching the tenth mouse of any color, this additional message appeared in the Hunter's Journal:

> I've collected all the XXX Robot Scraps needed for a fully-functional super-robot XXX!

After collecting all 50 scraps, another message appeared in the Hunter's Journal:

> I've collected all the robot scraps I can! I should visit Ronza to turn all this into a powerful super-robot trap!

After a hunter has all 50 scraps and the Repurposed Robot Head, the Heads-up Display adds a message "You've got the parts! Complete the trap in Ronza's Shoppe!"

After buying the Ultra MegaMouser MechaBot Trap, the Heads-Up Display changes to a picture of the two robots facing one another, initially with a message "Arm your Ultra MegaMouser MechaBot Trap to fight back!". There is also a Boss meter at the bottom of the Heads-up Display, with a hint that states "Each Super FighterBot MegaSupreme catch does 10 damage to their HP! The Super FighterBot MegaSupreme has 100/100 HP."

After arming the Ultra MegaMouser MechaBot Trap, the original five Force Fighter mice cannot be attracted, but it is then possible to attract the Super FighterBot MegaSupreme mouse. Each failed hunt that attracted the Super FighterBot MegaSupreme shows an animation of it firing a barrage of missiles at the hunter; and each successful catch shows an animation of the hunter's MegaMouser charging the FighterBot with a large explosion. Each catch weakens the FighterBot by 10 HP, with the following message in the Hunter's Journal:

> Your rocket-powered fist connected solidly, dealing 10 damage, leaving the robot with only XX HP remaining!

Finally, after defeating the FighterBot 10 times, the hunter was awarded the Crushed Birthday Cake Base, along with this message in the journal:

> Your super-robot has proven to be more powerful, defeating and demoralizing the Mouse Force Five! Their main charge has been blunted and Ronza has been saved!
With their spirit broken, the Mouse Force Five are now simply watching from the sidelines and no longer actively attacking Ronza. Who would, with you protecting her?
With the robot threat deterred, you finally have time to collect your, ah, slightly crushed reward.
You pick up the following loot:
1 Crushed Birthday Cake Base

Thereafter, a third Heads-up Display background is shown, with a View again link for replaying the final battle.

### Force Fighter Action Figure

> Oh wow, these... These aren't particularly well-made action figures, are they? The paint's not quite the right colour, the male bodies and the female bodies are exactly the same, they're missing critical costume features, and - ow! That's a splinter!
I guess the reason the Mouse Force Five have so many of these on-hand is that nobody will buy them.

All five action figure collectibles (blue, green, pink, red, and yellow) have the same description. There was no limit on the amount a hunter could collect. The Event Scoreboard allowed hunters to compare who had collected the most.

During the annual MouseHunt Birthday, Hunters were able to trade in these collectibles for Party Charms at the event Charm Shoppe, but have been rendered obsolete since the conclusion of Birthday Party Zone, Mousehunt's Ninth Birthday

### Robot Scrap

> This scrap may not look like much now, but collect enough of them, and you can build a super-robot of your own to challenge the Mouse Force Five!

All five scrap types (blue leg, green arm, pink leg, red chest, and yellow arm) have the same description. A hunter could own at most 10 of a given color scrap at the same time.

### Repurposed Robot Head

> It's amazing what you can do with the scrap laying around - so long as it's high-quality scrap, anyway. And who would have higher-quality scrap than Ronza?
Made from spare trap parts and coated in melted gold accumulated through years of fantastic sales, this head should slot right to complete your Ultra MegaMouser MechaBot Trap.

This head could be purchased from Ronza's Traveling Shoppe General Store for 100,000 gold, and could be returned for the same value. A hunter could own at most one at a time.

## History and Trivia

- The Travel map showed images of the Super FighterBot MegaSupreme emerging from the Harbour and approaching the eventual event site, starting on 4 March 2013.
- The Force Fighter Five were introduced on 7 March 2013.
- These mice are based on the Power Rangers, a popular television series.

| Resting high above Moussu Picchu among the clouds, Ful'Mina is the true queen of the mountain and ruler over the skies and storms. As the Moussu Picchu Inhabitants below battle endlessly for dominance of the weather, the resulting stalemate allows the queen to slumber for generations.<br>Once, long ago, she would appear high above the land anywhere a lightning cloud hovered, visiting the many realms of mice across Gnawnia, her tail smacking the ground like lightning as she plucked treasures with it to add to her hoard. Now, countless decades pass in between sightings of the Mountain Queen, so much so that her very existence has gone from folklore, to legend, to mere myth...<br>But now, MouseHunters from the Kingdom of Gnawnia have found their way through the mountain pass, and their presence has brought a shift to the power struggle in these ruins, as they always do. Hunters have begun to harness the powers of both the Wind Wanderer and Rain Roamer tribes of mice in the area, ironically bringing unity between the two after endless centuries of feuding.<br>As the winds grow stronger, the rains fall heavier, and the storms begin to mix and clash, great bone-shaking growls can be heard from above the thickest of clouds, where the queen is said to reside. Is this thunder? Or is it the great Mountain Queen being rudely awakened from her slumber? Slowly but surely, disturbed by the intensifying battle in the lands below and the low rumble of impending thunderstorms in the clouds upon which she rests, she begins to rouse from her deep sleep...<br>Soon, and without warning, Ful'Mina, the Mountain Queen, will descend upon the lands with great fury to bring order to the chaos through the destructive force of her indomitable lightning storms. |  |  |  |

The Gargantuamouse can be attracted by any Standard Cheese.

## Hunting Strategy

The Gargantuamouse can be attracted when the Hunter's Streak is at 7 or higher in Fiery Warpath. Its attraction rate increases when the Streak gets higher.

The Hunter can use Gargantua Charm to remove all mice except the Gargantuamouse from the attraction pool when the required Streak is reached, thus guarantees the next attraction being the Gargantuamouse.

Draconic power type is very effective against this mouse. Arcane, Physical, Tactical, and Hydro are less effective against it.

When the Hunter fails to capture a Gargantuamouse, the following message will appear on the Hunter's Journal:

> Fearing that I was gaining the upper hand, the Warmonger released a Gargantuamouse, putting an end to my streak.

# 🐭 Goliath Field Mouse

> **Entity**: Mouse_lore

The Goliath Field Mouse is a breed of mouse found in the Gnawnia Rift location. They are known to drop Ancient Relics, Divine Orbs and Raw Rift Crystals as loot.

| Goliath Field Mouse |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mouse Group: Rift Walkers (Gnawnia Rift) |  |  |  |
| Mouse Statistics |  |  |  |
| Points: | 119,000 | Gold: | 15,000 |
| Location & Attraction Info |  |  |  |
| Required Power Types: | Rift | Other Requirements: | None |
| Cheese: | Resonator | Charm: | None |
| Locations: | Gnawnia Rift | Loot: | Ancient RelicDivine OrbRaw Rift Crystal |
| Links |  |  |  |
| Larry's Loot Lexicon: | MouseHunt Info Page | Image: | Image Link |
| Sleeping for centuries at a time, the Goliath Field mouse is a Rift wonder in itself. The Rift energies flow through the Goliath mice, allowing life to grow around them as they slumber. Some believe their dreams influence what grows on them. A Rift-seeking hunter would be incredibly lucky to see one moving in his lifetime.You'll feel a tremble at first, followed by seismic shaking. That low rumbling off in the distance turns into a roar as mountains crash together all around you! That's when you know... it has awakened. |  |  |  |
|  | Mouse ID#: 558 |  |  |

## Preferred Cheese

Goliath Field mice have been found to be especially attracted to Resonator cheese, to the point that any other kind of cheese will simply not suffice.

## Hunting Strategy

Like all mice in the Gnawnia Rift, Goliath Field mice can be caught with any power type except Parental. However, due to all types except Rift being less effective against the mice in the area, it is in a hunter's best interest to focus on catching one Goliath Field as soon as possible, to gain the Crystal Tower trap (and the Riftwalker Set bonus if the hunter already has the Rift Base), to make all mice in the area easier to catch. If a hunter does not want to use an Ultimate charm, then Ultimate Power Charms coupled with the hunter's strongest non-Rift trap show a remarkable improvement in catch rate compared to any other charm.

Catching a hunter's first Goliath Field Mouse leaves a message in the Hunter's Journal:

> With the capture of the Goliath Field Mouse, the Gnawnia Rift lost a significant amount of its power.
The entrance to the Rift appears to have shrunk, making the Kingdom a bit safer from the threat of this Rift. Despite the fact no mouse can currently leave this Rift, I shall continue to endeavour to return when needed, hunting the mice here to ensure this Rift never tears wide open again!
Although I have saved the Kingdom for the time being, I fear that in time Rifts will open in other areas of the Kingdom.

## Event Participation

### Spring Egg Hunt

- The Goliath Field Mouse drops the Enlarged Rift Egg during the annual Spring Egg Hunt.

## History and Trivia

- Goliath Field mice were introduced on 25 March 2014, with the introduction of the Rift Plane.
- Goliath Field mice are the Rift version of Field mice.
- Goliath Field mouse is potentially the heaviest mouse found in the game when caught.

|  | Mouse ID#: 426 |  |  |

## Preferred Cheese

Grubling mice have been found to be only attracted to Dewthief Camembert.

## Hunting Strategy

The Grubling mouse is a member of the Sand Dunes mouse group. As such all power types except Shadow weapons are ineffective against it.

It can only be attracted during the Grubling Stampede Minigame, if the hunter has Grubling Chow Charms armed.

## History and Trivia

- Grubling mice were released on 14 November 2012, as part of the Living Garden update.

# 🐭 Hardboiled Mouse

> **Entity**: Mouse_lore

The Hardboiled Mouse is an Event Mouse found during the annual Spring Egg Hunt event.

| Hardboiled Mouse |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mouse Group: Event Mice (Spring Egg Hunt) |  |  |  |
| Mouse Statistics |  |  |  |
| Points: | 3,200 | Gold: | 125 |
| Location & Attraction Info |  |  |  |
| Required Power Types: | All types | Other Requirements: | See current Spring Egg Hunt location |
| Cheese: | See current Spring Egg Hunt location | Charm: | See current Spring Egg Hunt location |
| Locations: | Spring Egg Hunt | Loot: | See current Spring Egg Hunt location |
| Links |  |  |  |
| Larry's Loot Lexicon: | MouseHunt Info Page | Image: | Image Link |
| Rain.<br>It never seemed to be sunny-side up in Gnawnia. At least, not whenever I was working a case. This one was a doozie but I knew I was close to cracking it.<br>Like everything else in this crazy world, it all came down to a doe. Easy enough on the eyes, I suppose, but when you're talking about eyes, you have to be careful. This doe had crazy eyes, and a crazy plan hatching behind them.<br>Situations like this never go over-easy. See, she'd gotten ahold of the last free Golden Egg in Gnawnia, and wired up this crazy contraption to it.<br>"A scrambler, get it?" she asked, eyes rolling. And then she laughed. That laugh. Like loose nails rattling around in a jar. Or on reflection, loose screws.<br>Her plan as I figured it, was to scramble up all the Eggscavators in the land and throw mice and hunters alike into wild confusion. Her motivation, however, was about as clear as runny yolk.<br>I had tracked her through Gnawnia's back alleys, from Cheese Bars to Mad Scientist Surplus Shoppes, and finally cornered her here. Still, she didn't seem upset. More pleased, actually. Perhaps at the opportunity to show off.<br>"I'm going to Scramble everything, do you understand? Everything! Ah ha ha ha ha!" That laugh again.<br>"Look, sister," I said, stepping carefully closer. "I know you think you have a job to do, but I do too. I'm here to bring you in, and you can come peacefully with me, or well, I know there's a few hunters around looking for you too, and you're gonna get poached if you're not careful."<br>At the mention of hunters, she flinched visibly. Her shell was crumbling, but breaking her so close to the frying pan was risky. I decided to take it easier on her. "If you hand over the device and come along quietly, we can put you in the Hunter Protection Program. You'll get a new name, a new house, a new job..."<br>"No!" she cried. "No new job! Science, mad science forever!" Then she pulled another strange-looking device from inside her tinfoil jacket, thumbed a button on top, and threw it at me. I ducked, there was a bright flash, and when I looked again, she was gone.<br>As my vision recovered, I noticed a trail of oil, nuts, and bolts leading away. My keen detective sense told me she'd gone that way, so I decided to follow.<br>She couldn't escape me for long. |  |  |  |
|  | Mouse ID#: 465 |  |  |

## Finding Event Mice

Information on how to locate and capture the Hardboiled Mouse can be found on the current Spring Egg Hunt event page.

## History and Trivia

- 25 March 2013: The Hardboiled Mouse was released as part of the Spring Egg Hunt 2013 event.
- The Hardboiled Mouse's appearance and description are reflective of the hardboiled crime fiction literary genre.

Their swift wings bring a dark plague of frustration to any hunter unfortunate enough to encounter them. |  |  |  |

In the Lagoon location, the Harpy Mouse has been found to be especially attracted to Gnarled and Wicked Gnarly cheeses, to the point that any other kind of cheese will simply not suffice.

### Charm

No Charms are required to attract the Harpy Mouse.

Hunters can encounter the Harpy Mouse only in the Lagoon location.

The Harpy Mouse drops Divine Orbs in the Lagoon location.

| Locations: | Fort Rox | Loot: | Ancient RelicAnimatronic BirdDivine OrbExtreme Ancient CharmFlawless OrbHowliteMeteoric Core FragmentsMeteorite PieceMoon CheeseSimple OrbSilver BoltSuper Ancient CharmSuper Cactus CharmUltimate CharmUltimate Ancient CharmUltimate Attraction CharmUltimate Luck CharmUltimate Power CharmUnstable Charm |
| Links |  |  |  |

| Nestled within the remnants of the Fort Rox meteor slumbers an incredible source of power. This tiny mouse courses with energy, presumed to be what radiates throughout the Fort Rox mice, causing all of the unique transformations.<br>Seemingly at peace and unaware of her surroundings, she is in a deep and powerful trance, emitting waves of bright, blinding light to supply her followers with their great strength and abilities.<br>Nothing can break her trance, save for the alluring source of sunlight from Sunrise Cheese... |  |  |  |
|  | Mouse ID#: 857 |  |  |

## Preferred Cheese

The Heart of the Meteor is only attracted to Sunrise Cheese.

## Hunting Strategy

To attract the Heart of the Meteor, the Hunter has to arm Sunrise Cheese in Heart of the Meteor phase in Fort Rox. A Fort Rox Portal Projector is required to enter this phase. Doing so will consume the Projector and add a Ruined Portal Projector to the Hunter's inventory.

The Heart of the Meteor is primarily weak to Arcane traps, though Shadow traps can be used to lesser effect.
The Hunter's Fort defenses have no effect in this phase. Tower Mana cannot be armed while hunting in this phase.
The Heart of the Meteor's power will be lowered with each attraction, to the point where it is a guaranteed catch on the 10th attraction.

Catching the Heart of the Meteor will return the Hunter to the Dawn phase and disarms Sunrise Cheese.

Upon catching the Heart of the Meteor, the following message is displayed in the Hunter's Journal:

> My trap somehow subdued the ferocity of the Heart of the Meteor!
With the creature defeated, the power of the Fort Rox Portal Projector faded and I found myself transported back into the Dawn, almost as if no time had passed at all.
I disarmed my Sunrise Cheese, as it would be no use here.
I must craft another Fort Rox Portal Projector and venture in for another challenge!

The Hunter may enter the Heart of the Meteor phase multiple times without affecting their Wall health or progress in the Dawn phase.

## History and Trivia

- 15 March 2017: The Heart of the Meteor was released with the expansion of the Fort Rox area.

| Points: | 2,000 | Gold: | 2,000 |

| Locations: | BazaarTraining Grounds | Loot: | Cheese Belt Token PackCheese Claw Token PackCheese Fang Token PackLucky Power CharmSplintered WoodSuper Lucky Power Charm |

| Larry's Loot Lexicon: | MouseHunt Info Page | Image: | Image Link |
| The Hope Mouse is altruistic by nature, wanting only to help others, be they human or mouse. The King has been so touched by the selflessness of these mice that he has sent out a decree. If any hunter should catch a Hope Mouse, dust him off and send him on his way, as he's likely off to do some good in the world.<br>He can be found scrounging for supplies in the Training Grounds and the Bazaar to give to those in need. |  |  |  |
|  | Mouse ID#: 100 |  |  |

## Cheese and Charm Preference

### Cheese

The Hope Mouse is attracted to Gilded and Standard Cheese in the Training Grounds, but only Standard Cheese in the Bazaar.

### Charm

No Charms are required to attract the Hope Mouse.

## Power Type Effectiveness

| Very Effective | Effective | Less Effective |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tactical | Physical | None |

## Loot

The Hope Mouse can drop:

- Cheese Belt Token Pack
- Cheese Claw Token Pack
- Cheese Fang Token Pack
- Lucky Power Charm
- Splintered Wood
- Super Lucky Power Charm

## History and Trivia

- 14 January 2010: The Hope Mouse was first released as the developers' response to the earthquake in Haiti.
Original description included additional two paragraphs that were later removed:

> Events unfolding in Haiti have sprung this mouse into action. We will be donating five cents to the Mission of Hope in Haiti for the first 200,000 of these mice caught. By sounding your horn you will help us reach our goal of raising $10,000.
We greatly encourage all MouseHunters to find a charity they are comfortable with and get involved.
When it was released, it could be found in various locations throughout the kingdom (Bazaar, Calm Clearing, Cape Clawed, Dojo, Great Gnarled Tree, Harbour, Laboratory, Meadow, Mountain, S.S. Huntington II, Town of Digby, and Training Grounds), but was later confined to just Training Grounds.

- Between 26 August and 21 September 2010: The Hope Mouse was released in various locations again, in response to the flooding in Pakistan. Its description has been changed, with the following paragraph added:

> Recent events in Pakistan have sprung this mouse into action! Many organizations, such as the Red Cross and World Vision, are currently helping out. Please consider giving them your support.
During that time the Hope Mouse could be found in Bazaar, Calm Clearing, Cape Clawed, Dojo, Great Gnarled Tree, Laboratory, Town of Gnawnia, Training Grounds, and S.S. Huntington II.

- 19 January 2011: The Hope Mouse sprang back into action, in response to flooding in several countries; the following paragraph was added to its description:

> Recent flooding in Australia, Brazil, Philippines and Sri Lanka have sprung this mouse into action! Many organizations, such as the Queensland Government, are currently helping out. Please consider giving them your support.

- 11 March 2011: The description changed in response to an earthquake and tsunami in Japan and the coastal areas across the Pacific basin. The following sentence was added:

> Recent natural disasters occurring in Japan and other parts of the world have sprung this mouse into action!
During that time the Hope Mouse could be found in a variety of locations including Calm Clearing, Cape Clawed, Dojo, Mountain, Town of Digby, Town of Gnawnia, Training Grounds, S.S. Huntington II and Windmill.

- 13 November 2013: After Typhoon Yolanda hit the Philippines, a note was temporarily added to its description:

> Join the discussionto see how you can help out too!

- 19 March 2024: The Hope Mouse was updated as part of the Valentine's Day event retirement. It's description was also updated to include the sentence:

> He can be found scrounging for supplies in the Training Grounds and the Bazaar to give to those in need.
Points: 1,000 -> 2,000
Gold: 1,000 -> 2,000

## External Link

- Mission of Hope

# 🐭 Icewing

> **Entity**: Mouse_lore

> "Icewing" redirects here. For more uses, see Icewing (disambiguation).

The Icewing is a breed of mouse found in the final zone of the Iceberg: Icewing's Lair. It is known to drop Ancient Relic, Deep Freeze Base Blueprints, Drill Charge, Hunting Research, Satchel of Gold, Steam Nine, War Scraps, Wax Charms, and Zugzwang's Scarf as loot.

| Icewing |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mouse Group: Icewing's Invasion (Misc) |  |  |  |
| Mouse Statistics |  |  |  |
| Points: | 51,250 | Gold: | 11,295 |
| Location & Attraction Info |  |  |  |
| Required Power Types: | Hydro | Other Requirements: | None |
| Cheese: | No Preference | Charm: | None |

| Larry's Loot Lexicon: | MouseHunt Info Page | Image: | Image Link |
| Legends tell of an ancient, hateful mouse, a child of wrath and ice, spoken about only in hushed tones around campfires to scare children and the weak-hearted. But this mouse is no fairy tale, and has a long and dark history with the Kingdom of Gnawnia.<br>Long ago, a powerful band of evil mice descended yearly upon Gnawnia in fearsome raids, stealing cheese and terrifying everyone. Icewing herself lead many a raid, and was next in line for rulership when the jealous chieftans banded together and cast her out, fearful that with her incredible power and cruelty, she would have done the same to them.<br>Over the years since, she has raised an army from the mice who remained loyal to her, and turned her sights to the south. Determined to prove that she can accomplish more without her traitorous clan holding her back, she intends to invade Gnawnia and see every mouse there swear fealty to her as their Queen. But first, she must wipe out the pesky humans who seem to get in the way of everything... |  |  |  |
|  | Mouse ID#: 385 |  |  |

## Preferred Cheese

The Icewing has no specific preference for any kind of cheese.

## Hunting Strategy

The Icewing can only be encountered after entering Icewing's Lair at least once previously, having caught a Frostwing Commander on the first occasion. The hunter must also not have taken more than 425 hunts.

Catching Icewing with Steam Laser Mk. II armed is the only way to obtain Steam Laser Mk. II (Broken!), which can in turn be smashed to obtain parts necessary for creating Steam Laser Mk. III.

Dragonbane Charm, Super Dragonbane Charm, Extreme Dragonbane Charm, and Ultimate Dragonbane Charm provide a power bonus against the Icewing.

## History and Trivia

- The Icewing was painted live on 3 December 2010 during an 'All about the art' Feedback Friday. Ideas and suggestions for how the mouse should look were provided by the audience at the time of painting.
- 24 May 2012: The Icewing was released as a part of the Iceberg.
- 1 June 2012: The Icewing began to drop additional loot.
- 14 June 2012: The Icewing began to drop Deep Freeze Base Blueprints as loot.
- On its original release, the Icewing could only be encountered and caught when the Steam Laser Mk. II or Steam Laser Mk. III weapons were armed. This weapon requirement was removed on 18 June 2012.
- 29 August 2012: The Icewing began dropping Ancient Relic as loot.
- 17 September 2024: The Dragonbane Charm, Super Dragonbane Charm, Extreme Dragonbane Charm, and Ultimate Dragonbane Charm was made effective against the Icewing.

# 🐭 King Grub Mouse

> **Entity**: Mouse_lore

The King Grub Mouse is a breed of mouse that can be found in the Sand Crypts, and is known to drop Dol Essences, Est Essences, Fel Essences and Lunaria Petals as loot.

| King Grub Mouse |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mouse Group: Sand Dunes Mice |  |  |  |
| Mouse Statistics |  |  |  |
| Points: | 35,000 | Gold: | 8,500 |
| Location & Attraction Info |  |  |  |
| Required Power Types: | Shadow | Other Requirements: | See Salting Minigame |
| Cheese: | Graveblossom Camembert | Charm: | Grub Scent Charm |
| Locations: | Sand Crypts | Loot: | Dol EssenceEst EssenceFel EssenceLunaria Petal |
| Links |  |  |  |
| Larry's Loot Lexicon: | MouseHunt Info Page | Image: | Image Link |
| This oversized grub has refused to morph into its true form. Instead, it continues to consume and increase its mass to an alarming size. This self-declared King rules through fear in the Sand Crypt, commanding other mice to bring him food and defend his lair at all costs. Luckily for him, the mice fear him more than they do a hunter's trap - plus it's not too hard to swipe the cheese without the King Grub mouse knowing.<br>Being a gigantic grub is about the equivalent to being a gigantic baby - not too smart but prone to loud and sometimes dangerous tantrums. Mice steer clear of him as best as they can, which is okay because he prefers it that way.<br>The short of all this, is that you'll never attract the King Grub to your trap without liberally slathering it with an appealing scent to attract him, and you'll never defeat him without heavily salting your trap for an added boost. |  |  |  |
|  | Mouse ID#: 428 |  |  |

## Hunting Strategy

Normally, King Grub Mouse can only be attracted with Graveblossom Camembert and Grub Scent Charm armed.
It can also be attracted without Grub Scent Charm if Smelly Sodium Base is armed and salt level is at 50.

King Grub Mouse is a member of the Sand Dunes Mice group. As such all power types except Shadow are ineffective against it.

Salting is recommended before trying to catch King Grub Mouse.

## History and Trivia

- 14 November 2012: The King Grub Mouse was introduced as part of the Sand Crypts location.

The Kung Fu Mouse will drop Luscious Lumber in the Training Grounds location when Hunters are working the Zurreal Trap Research Assignment.
6 Luscious Lumber are required to construct the Zurreal's Folly weapon.

The Kung Fu Mouse is not known to drop any other loot in the Training Grounds location.

## History and Trivia

- 10 October 2008: The Kung Fu Mouse was released in the Training Grounds, accompanied by Archer and Samurai mice.
- 27 November 2008: The Kung Fu Mouse's habitat expanded to the Dojo when Hunters accessed the Furoma Pagoda locations for the first time.
- 11 December 2008: The Kung Fu Mouse began to drop Satchels of Gold worth 500 gold as additional loot.
- 23 August 2011: The Kung Fu Mouse began to drop Luscious Lumber as loot in the Training Grounds as part of the Zurreal Trap Research Assignment
- 29 July 2015: The Kung Fu Mouse stopped dropping Ticket to the Burroughs Bazaar.

## History and Trivia

- The name and visual appearance of the Lycan Mouse is based on common incarnations of the lycanthrope legend.
- 10 October 2008: The Lycan Mouse is released in the Mousoleum and drops Shredded Furoma Map Piece, allowing access to the Training Grounds
- January 2009: For a brief period, the Lycan Mouse was also attracted to Cheddar Cheese in the Mousoleum.
- June 2010: The Lycan Mouse was removed from the population of mice available in the Training Grounds. This explains why the Lycan Mouse drops the Furoma map piece. In the Training Grounds, the Lycan Mouse was known to drop Radioactive Blue Cheese as loot.
- 14 April 2011: The Lycan Mouse began dropping the Antique Green Plaid Egg in the Catacombs as part of the Spring Egg Hunt 2011 event.
- 18 April 2011: The Lycan Mouse began dropping the Antique Wavy Purple Egg in the Mousoleum as part of the Spring Egg Hunt 2011 event.
- 29 July 2015: The strength of the Lycan Mouse was reduced and its chance of encounter was increased in the Mousoleum.
- 17 October 2018: The Lycan Mouse stops dropping Shredded Furoma Map Piece in the Mousoleum as part of the Burroughs area overhaul.

| The apex of modern mouseology and mousegineering. Combining years' worth of mouse ethology gathered from the top hunters in Gnawnia, the best and brightest minds out of Digby and the top secret equipment held in Laboratory Room #54 resulted in this: the M400 Prototype.Designed to adapt and camouflage itself as all known breeds of mice, it lives among them in order to analyze and document different mouse behaviours in the wild. Advanced defences make it uncatchable to stay out of hunters' traps, and equally advanced weaponry defends itself against suspicious adversaries.The perfect mouse... A little TOO perfect. Once the behavioural modules went live, it became sentient, with the belief that it actually was a unique, wild breed of mouse! It easily broke free and has avoided all attempts at recapture.This "new" breed is next to impossible to find. Recent sightings show that it seems to have made some improvements on itself and the M400 has been spotted in multiple regions simultaneously. Leading us to believe it has some how figured out how to clone itself... What have we done!? |  |  |  |
|  | Mouse ID#: 547 |  |  |

## Hunting Strategy

To catch M400, the Hunter must do the following Library Assignments:

- 1: M400 Bait Research Assignment to obtain Fusion Fondue
- 2: M400 Hunting Research Assignment to track down M400 itself

The mouse requires Fusion Fondue in a designate location when the Hunter is at Step 10 of the Hunting Research Assignment.
Only Physical and Tactical power types work against this mouse.
EMP400 Charm provides a bonus of 25,000 Power against M400.

Fusion Fondue is automatically disarmed upon catching this mouse.

In addition to the normal message about completing a Library Assignment, catching an M400 also leaves this message in the Hunter's Journal:

> Just as it was captured, the M400 mouse fired an emergency EMP blast, disarming my bait and warning other M400 Mice in the area!
I will have to start another research assignment to locate where the M400 are now hiding.

The Madame Bogarty can only be attracted while writing a story.

All other types are ineffective.

- 13 January 2026: Madame Bogarty was released as part of Conclusion Cliffs location.

## Preferred Cheese

Magma Carrier mice have been found to be especially attracted to Spicy Havarti cheese, to the point that any other kind of cheese will simply not suffice.

Shadow type traps such as the Clockapult of Time are very effective against Magma Carrier mice. All traps with other power types, including Arcane type traps such as the Obelisk of Slumber, are ineffective against these mice.

## History and Trivia

- During the Spring Egg Hunt 2011, Magma Carrier mice began dropping a bonus Jungle of Dread Egg as loot for hunters who had obtained the Rocket Rabbit Mallet. They dropped the same loot the following year during the Spring Egg Hunt 2012 event for hunters who had obtained the Eggscavator.
- 29 July 2015: The Magma Carrier Mouse stopped dropping Laboratory Map Piece.

| Master Burglar Mouse |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mouse Group: Indigenous Mice (Shiny Seekers) |  |  |  |
| Mouse Statistics |  |  |  |
| Points: | 4,260 | Gold: | 2,500 |
| Location & Attraction Info |  |  |  |
| Required Power Types: | Any typeexceptRift | Other Requirements: | None |
| Cheese: | Gilded CheeseSUPER&#124;brie+ | Charm: | None |
| Locations: | BazaarTown of Gnawnia | Loot: | Brie CheeseCrown JewelFlawless OrbSatchel of Gold (1,000) |
| Links |  |  |  |
| Larry's Loot Lexicon: | MouseHunt Info Page | Image: | Image Link |
| Regular Burglar mice merely pick pockets... Master Burglar mice stage elaborate heists. Attracted only to Gilded Cheese and SUPER&#124;brie+, Master Burglar mice eschew any aspect of life that isn’t gold or diamond-encrusted. Catching a Master Burglar Mouse in the Bazaar is well worth the effort. In the past, they have been known to drop precious items, and this time, rumor has it that the Master Burglar mice have run off with one of the King's crown jewels! |  |  |  |
|  | Mouse ID#: 120 |  |  |

## Cheese and Charm Preference

### Cheese

The Master Burglar Mouse can only be attracted with SUPER|brie+ or Gilded Cheese.

### Charm

No Charms are required to attract the Master Burglar Mouse.

## Power Type Weaknesses

The Master Burglar Mouse has a predominate weakness to Law weapons, but is found in locations were using a Law trap would be less effective against the other mice that Hunters will encounter.
It is recommended that Hunters use a trap that will be effective against the main mouse population in their hunting location.

| VeryEffective | Effective | Less Effective |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Law | PhysicalShadowTacticalArcaneForgottenHydroDraconic | None |

## Locations

Hunters can encounter the Master Burglar Mouse in the Bazaar and Town of Gnawnia locations.

## Loot

The Master Burglar Mouse drops the following loot:

- Bazaar

> Brie Cheese
Crown Jewel
Flawless Orb
Satchel of Gold (1,000)

The Crown Jewel is required for obtaining the King's Gauntlet Floorplan, which can be purchased in the Bazaar Cartographer.
The King's Gauntlet Floorplan is required for Hunters to access the King's Gauntlet location.

- Town of Gnawnia

> Brie Cheese
Satchel of Gold (1,000)

The Master Burglar Mouse will drop the Encyclopedia Gnawnia in the Town of Gnawnia when working the Zurreal Trap Research Assignment.
The Encyclopedia Gnawnia is necessary for crafting the Zurreal's Folly weapon.

## History and Trivia

- 9 September 2008: The Master Burglar Mouse was initially a single mouse of his kind. He was released during the $2,500 Tuesday event. He had stolen the King of Gnawnia's crown and every Hunter was encouraged to do their utmost to capture it and recover the crown. On the following day, the mouse was caught by a lucky hunter, who won $1,000 (CAD) for her efforts.
- The description for the Master Burglar Mouse has changed since its release. The original description read as follows:

> More ambitious than regular Burglar mice, the Master Burglar enjoys theft on a much grander scale. Most recently one such mouse was daring enough to steal the King of Gnawnia's crown! Devastated, the King urges his hunters to go forth and capture this mouse!

- According to the developers, the Master Burglar Mouse is named Bob.
- 8 June 2010: The Master Burglar Mouse was reintroduced as a breed with the release of MouseHunt version 3.0.
- 25 January 2011: The Master Burglar Mouse began to drop Flawless Orbs as loot.
- 23 August 2011: The Master Burglar Mouse began to drop the Encyclopedia Gnawnia as loot in the Town of Gnawnia.
- 25 June 2013: The Master Burglar Mouse gained a vulnerability to Law power type traps, with the release of Varmint Valley.
- 25 March 2014: The Master Burglar Mouse gained a vulnerability to Rift power type traps, with the introduction of the Rift Plane.
- 29 July 2015: The Master Burglar Mouse is no longer found in King's Arms, and no longer drops the Crown Jewel in the Town of Gnawnia.

# 🐭 Mice

> **Entity**: Mouse_lore

> "Mouse" redirects here. For other uses, see Mouse (disambiguation).

Catching the army of mice that are invading the Kingdom of Gnawnia is the main goal in MouseHunt!

## Mouse Attributes

Each mouse has the following attributes:

- Mouse Power

> The strength of a mouse. It is reflected as a comparison against your current Trap Power and Power Type.
In ascending order, it is given as one of the following: "effortless", "easy", "moderate", "challenging", "difficult", "overpowering", "near impossible", or "impossible".

- Mouse Group

> One of 48 Mouse Groups: Indigenous Mice, Dock Dwellers, Mountain Mice, Forest Guild, Lab Experiments, The Shadow Clan, Digby Dirt Dwellers, Followers of Furoma, The Forgotten Mice, Aquatic Order, The Elub Tribe, The Nerg Tribe, The Derr Tribe, The Dreaded Horde, Draconic Brood, Balack's Banished, Gauntlet Gladiators, Seasonal Soldiers, Wizard's Pieces, Zurreal's Breed, Icewing's Invasion, Wild Bunch, Train Robbers, Meteorite Miners, The Marching Flame, Muridae Market Mice, Living Garden Mice, Lost City Mice, Sand Dunes Mice, Queso Canyoneers, Deep Sea Dwellers, Fungal Fiends, Citizens of Zokor, Moussu Picchu Inhabitants, Floating Islanders, Foreword Farmers, Prologue Pond Prowlers, Storytellers, Beanstalkers, Sorcery Apprentices, Dragons of the Depths, Afterword Anti-Arborists, Epilogue Ecosystem, Conclusion Cliffhangers, Rift Walkers, Rift Stalkers, The Polluted or Event Mice.

- Gold Value

> The amount of gold received for each catch. Mice of the same breed always award the same amount of gold.

- Points Value

> The amount of points received for each catch. Mice of the same breed always award the same amount of points.

- Loot

> What the mouse might drop when caught. Drops are usually specific to a location. Not all mice drop loot.

- Preferred Cheese

> Penchant for a particular cheese. When using a preferred cheese, the mouse is encountered more often than usual. Not all mice have a preference. Additionally, not all have equally strong preferences - some mice are simply more likely to be encountered, while some are only encountered with one specific cheese. Cheese preferences listed in the table below, as well as on individual mouse pages, are listed alphabetically, not in order of preference.

- Mouse Weight

> The heaviness of a mouse, expressed in pounds and ounces. The weight has no impact on gameplay currently, historically, the gold and points of a mouse were varied depending on the weight of the mouse, with heavier mice giving more gold but less points.

## Complete Mouse Listing

# 🐭 Micro Mouse

> **Entity**: Mouse_lore

The Micro Mouse is a breed of mouse found in the Gnawnia Rift location. They are known to drop Riftiago Potions and Ionized Salt as loot.

| Micro Mouse |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mouse Group: Rift Walkers (Gnawnia Rift) |  |  |  |
| Mouse Statistics |  |  |  |
| Points: | 28,000 | Gold: | 3,400 |
| Location & Attraction Info |  |  |  |
| Required Power Types: | Rift | Other Requirements: | None |
| Cheese: | Brie StringMagical String | Charm: | None |
| Locations: | Gnawnia Rift | Loot: | Ionized SaltRiftiago Potion |
| Links |  |  |  |
| Larry's Loot Lexicon: | MouseHunt Info Page | Image: | Image Link |
| Smaller than a single blade of Riftgrass, he has a hard time being heard let alone being taken seriously! Frustrated with being constantly overlooked by everyone, he tries to climb as high as possible to have a chance at being heard!If you listen carefully enough you can hear him saying "I get no respect!" |  |  |  |
|  | Mouse ID#: 567 |  |  |

## Preferred Cheese

Micro mice have been found to be especially attracted to Brie String and Magical String Cheese, to the point that any other kind of cheese will simply not suffice.

## Event Participation

### Spring Egg Hunt

- The Micro Mouse drops the Enlarged Rift Egg during the annual Spring Egg Hunt.

### Other Events

- 2014

> Halloween 2014

## History and Trivia

- Micro mice were introduced on 25 March 2014, with the introduction of the Rift Plane.
- Micro mice are the Rift version of Tiny mice.

# 🐭 Mighty Mite Mouse

> **Entity**: Mouse_lore

Mighty Mite Mouse is a breed of mouse found in Foreword Farm.

| Mighty Mite Mouse |  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mouse Group: Foreword Farmers (Petulant Pests) |  |  |  |
| Mouse Statistics |  |  |  |
| Points: | 60,000 | Gold: | 10,000 |
| Location & Attraction Info |  |  |  |
| Required Power Types: | Tactical | Other Requirements: | 3 plants growing |
| Cheese: | Standard Cheese | Charm: | None |
| Locations: | Foreword Farm | Loot: | Condensed CreativityCrop Coin |
| Links |  |  |  |
| Larry's Loot Lexicon: | MouseHunt Info Page | Image: | Image Link |
| What this miniscule mouse lacks in size, it more than makes up for in brute strength, bravado, and showmanship! He thrives on showing off his impressive physique to the other pests that frequent the Foreword Farm but his fragile ego prevents him from doing so until the field is full of plants for him to lift. Hunters should be warned that this tiny terror won't go down without a fight but if they can manage to best him then they'll collect a sizeable reward of Crop Coins for their trouble. |  |  |  |
|  | Mouse ID#: 1112 |  |  |

## Cheese Preference

Mighty Mite Mouse can be attracted with any Standard Cheese.

## Hunting Strategy

Mighty Mite Mouse is available when 3 plants are growing.

Tactical power type is effective against Mighty Mite Mouse.
All other types are ineffective.

## Loot

Mighty Mite Mouse can drop:

- Condensed Creativity
- Crop Coin

## History and Trivia

- 26 July 2022: Mighty Mite Mouse was released as part of Foreword Farm location.

## Cheese and Charm Preference

### Cheese

The Mild Spicekin Mouse is only attracted to Mild Queso, Medium Queso, or Hot Queso.

### Charm

No Charms are required to attract the Mild Spicekin Mouse.

## Hunting Strategy

Only Draconic traps are effective against the Mild Spicekin Mouse, all other power types are ineffective. The Mild Spicekin Mouse can only be encountered in Queso Geyser while either a Tiny Eruption, Small Eruption, Medium Eruption, Large Eruption or a Epic Eruption is triggered.

Dragonbane Charm, Super Dragonbane Charm, Extreme Dragonbane Charm, and Ultimate Dragonbane Charm provide a power bonus against the Mild Spicekin Mouse.

## History and Trivia

- 30 April 2019: The Mild Spicekin Mouse was introduced, with the release of the Queso Geyser area.

|  | Mouse ID#: 687 |  |  |

## Preferred Cheese

Monstrous Black Widow mice have been found to be especially attracted to Lactrodectus Lancashire, to the point that any other kind of cheese will simply not suffice.

## Loot

The loot dropped by Monstrous Black Widow depends on the number of factions that are at 50 rage. Generally, she drops better loot as more factions are at 50 rage. With at least one faction, Rift Ultimate Power Charm is added to the loot; with two factions, Rift Ultimate Luck Charm is added to the mix, and with all three factions, Plankrun's Whisker Woods Rift Notes (if not already possessed) and another random item are added as loot.

| Factions at 50 rage | Loot (cumulative) |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | Ancient Relic<br>Divine Orb<br>Rift Cherries<br>Rift-torn Roots<br>Sap-filled Thorns<br>Widow's Web (Chance of +1 Web added at 3 Factions at 50 rage) |
| 1 | Rift Ultimate Power Charm |
| 2 | Rift Ultimate Luck Charm |
| 3 | Bolt of Cloth<br>Calcified Rift Mist<br>Cherry Charm<br>Gnarled Charm<br>Gnarled Potion<br>Greater Wicked Gnarly Potion<br>Luck Charm<br>Lucky Power Charm<br>Magical String Cheese<br>Plankrun's Whisker Woods Rift Notes<br>Power Charm<br>Radioactive Sludge<br>Rift Power Charm<br>Rope<br>Satchel of Gold (10,000, 50,000 or 100,000 gold)<br>Scrap Metal<br>Splintered Wood<br>Stagnant Charm<br>Super Luck Charm<br>Super Power Charm<br>Super Rotten Charm<br>Taunting Charm<br>Wicked Gnarly Potion |

## Hunting Strategy

Monstrous Black Widow mice are weak to Rift Traps, and is the first Rift Walker mouse that is not susceptible to any other weapon power type. They can only be attracted by Lactrodectus Lancashire, which is only effective when all three factions have a Rage of at least 25. The probability of attracting Monstrous Black Widow instead of any other mouse goes up as a hunter has more rage.

A hunter will generally need to use some funnel charms (Cherry, Gnarled, or Stagnant) to reach the required rage, since without them, the usual mouse population generally favors the first faction to reach 25 to reach that mini-boss before the other two factions have a chance to reach 25. Therefore, one strategy for getting all three factions to 50 rage is to start a cycle with normal hunting reaches 25 rage for one faction, then use funnel charms to get the other two factions to 25 (the chance of a +2 rage mouse from the first faction will make the other two factions reach 25 faster), then resume normal hunting to get one faction to 48 or 49, then resume funnel hunting until all factions are at 48 or 49. As long as no faction is at 50, then there is no risk of a mini-boss resetting rage and losing out on the chance for a Monstrous Black Widow. But as soon as a faction is at 50, the hunter has to switch to a strategy that reduces the risk of resetting rage by an accidental mini-boss catch, either by arming a Taunting Charm, or intentionally switching to a much weaker trap setup that can still catch the remaining regular mice needed while missing the mini-boss.

Overall, the safest way to catch a Monstrous Black Widow without risking an accidental mini-boss catch is to reach the highest rage possible without hitting 50. Since funnel charms attract mice that can increase the rage by 6, any hunt with a funnel charm when the rage is 44 or over risks hitting 50. Therefore, funnel charms should only be used as long as the rage is 43 or below. When all three factions are over 43, the Monstrous Black Widow is at its highest attraction rate without risking hitting 50 rage on any faction.

## Event Participation

### Spring Egg Hunt

- The Monstrous Black Widow Mouse drops the Enlarged Rift Egg and the Rift Venom Egg during the annual Spring Egg Hunt.

## History and Trivia

- Monstrous Black Widow mice were introduced on 28 January 2015, with the introduction of the Whisker Woods Rift.
- Monstrous Black Widow mice are the Rift version of Black Widow mice.

## Hunting Strategy

Monstrous Midge Mouse is available when 3 Twisted Parable Papyrus plants are growing.

Tactical power type is very effective against Monstrous Midge Mouse.
All other types are ineffective.

## Loot

Monstrous Midge Mouse can drop:

- Ancient Relic
- Condensed Creativity
- Parable Papyrus

## History and Trivia

- 27 September 2022: Monstrous Midge Mouse was released as part of Foreword Farm expansion.
