> Over the years, many important bases were designed to aid hunters who were looking to tame and cultivate the Living and Twisted Gardens, break the curses of the Lost and Cursed Cities, and survive the harsh climates of the Sand Dunes and Crypts.
> One contained the power of an aurora at any time of the year, at any time of the day, and localized entirely within the base. Another contained a lovely flowerbed of poinsettias kept fresh inside a fully sealed and functional hothouse. Another was made from a highly unstable metallic alloy that produced a bizarre chemical reaction when exposed to massive amounts of sodium chloride. And another harnessed mystical energies that warded against heinous curses.
> Each of these miraculous bases had their own unique effects and unfortunately, the designs for each of them have long been lost to the Trapsmiths of Gnawnia... until now! It turns out that the villainous Captain Crook discovered and then stole these lost blueprints during her raid of the Living Garden so that she could make her own pirated versions. However, she got the blueprints for each all mixed up and couldn't tell them apart so she combined them into something new that has the effects of all four!
> Now that the design secrets have been recovered, the Trapsmith at the Cerulean Skyport is able to forge this new, stronger, and shinier version using the miraculous combination of Cerulean Chrome that has been charged with the energy from Adorned Empyrean Jewels!

> • 50% chance to break any curse in the Lost/Cursed City upon catching a mouse

> Two different important bases were once built specifically for use at Moussu Picchu. The first, known as the Forecaster Base, was originally a sophisticated weather forecasting device that had the "unexpected feature" of actually intensifying the weather instead of merely predicting it. The second, known as the Storm Condenser Base, was a device constructed from repurposed hailstone that had a powerful coil and fan capable of capturing and neutralizing stormy weather.
> Both of these miraculous base designs were lost to the Trapsmiths of Gnawnia... until now! It turns out that the villainous Captain Crook discovered and then stole these lost blueprints during her raid of Moussu Picchu so that she could make her own pirated versions. However, she got the blueprints for each all mixed up and couldn't tell them apart so she combined them into something new that has the effects of both!
> Now that the design secrets have been recovered, the Trapsmith at the Cerulean Skyport is able to forge this new, stronger, and shinier version using the miraculous combination of Cerulean Chrome that has been charged with the energy from Adorned Empyrean Jewels!
> While hunting in Moussu Picchu, hunters will be able to switch this base to one of the following modes:
> Forecasting Mode:
> Doubles the weather intensity gained on every successful catch based on the type of cheese that is armed
> Condensing Mode:
> Prevents the weather intensity from increasing

## 🔨 Asal-Usul & Perakitan (Crafting/Shoppe)
The Chrome Stormcaster Base can be purchased from the Trapsmith in Cerulean Skyport for:

- 5,000,000 Gold
- 20 Chrome Stormcaster Blueprint Scrap
- 200 Cerulean Chrome Ingot
- 3 Adorned Empyrean Jewel

It requires the Hunter to own the Chrome Base and complete the Liberate the Cerulean Skyport from Captain Crook adventure to purchase.

It cannot be refunded.

# ⚔️ Chesla's Revenge Trap

> **Entity**: Equipment | **Element**: Tactical | **Rank**: Lord/Lady

> **Classification**: Tactical Weapon  
> **Power / Luck**: 5,000 Power | 16 Luck  
> **Title Requirement**: Lord/Lady  
> **Acquisition Cost**: 0

## 📜 Lore & Rekayasa Perangkap

> Hunting with the Chesla's Revenge Trap in the Seasonal Garden has the chance to overload it and increase the amount of amplification gained per catch. Just... keep your distance...
> Anna Chesla was a world-renowned inventor and chess master, best known for her patented "Advanced Chess" method. Her final invention, Chesla's Revenge, was named by her followers after her mysterious disappearance who saw it as one last attempt to best her bitter arch-rival, Zugzwang.
> Ancient rival of Zugzwang, Chesla was never able to defeat the chess master and would frustratingly return time and time again to the Seasonal Garden, biding her time until she was charged up for another attempt. With near perfect mastery of the technological advances of the time, she refused to admit her lack of mastery for chess.
> With the focus on charging her Amplifier to enter the tower, she couldn't spare much time for focus on improving her chess tactics. Out of her frustration, she had an epiphany! Using her great technological prowess, she quickly built an extremely powerful coil to gather and focus the magic energies of the Seasonal Garden, greatly accelerating her amplification rate!
> Finally being able to focus her energies elsewhere, she had turned up the power too high in anticipation and overloaded the coils. When the bright glow from the coil finally dimmed, she was never seen again.
> The power from the coil was not enough to destroy her, and many conflicting theories about her disappearance surfaced over the years, but no one truly knows what became of Anna...
> Scrawled upon the underside of the tower, one can make out the word "Checkmate".

## 🔨 Asal-Usul & Perakitan (Crafting/Shoppe)
The Chesla's Revenge Trap is a limited edition weapon not sold by any Trapsmith, and is therefore non-refundable. It can only be acquired through the opening of a Season 2 Treasure Chest:

It will always be equipped with the right spell for the job! Incorporate the droid with an Animatronic Bird and capture Arcane mice with ease!
> This updated model has a reduced probability over the previous version of uttering the wrong words causing unintended side effects including but not limited to...
> • Balding
> • Turning your gold into a pile of stinky socks
> • Turning your cheese into a pile of stinky gold
> • Making everything disappear
> • Destroying Gnawnia
> • Ending all life as we know it
> • Ducks
> Other than that small list of basically harmless side-effects, this trap is great! We promise!

> Once a mouse crosses the event horizon, the gravitational pull becomes so strong that escape becomes impossible!
> Although, you won't really see this happen. As the mice pass through the horizon, they will appear to freeze in place as they fall infinitely into the center, slowly redshifting until they eventually disappear from sight.
> The mouse, however, will experience gravity at a magnitude so strong that it will experience something known as "spaghettification". This is a very scientific term which means it will be stretched out into a long length of atoms, laid out side by side, resembling a string of spaghetti, pulled infinitely apart until the space between them is so great that only darkness remains.
> At least... That's what is believed will happen. No one has ever gone in and returned to tell about it, or properly observed it. Perhaps a hunter will reach too close by mistake when placing their cheese and become an unwilling test subject. Their noble and honourable sacrifice will prove to be invaluable to the world of science.

# ⚔️ Father Winter's Timepiece Trap

> **Entity**: Equipment | **Element**: Forgotten | **Rank**: Legendary

> **Classification**: Forgotten Weapon  
> **Power / Luck**: 5,000 Power | 8 Luck  
> **Title Requirement**: Legendary  
> **Acquisition Cost**: 25,000 Gold40 Snowflake Sugar Cookies10 Ornament Sugar Cookies

## 📜 Lore & Rekayasa Perangkap

> A cold and dreary hour glass recovered from the North Pole snow. Thought to be the original timepiece used by Father Winter himself, This long-lost and forgotten artifact has been fashioned into a quite powerful apparatus. Normally powered by the magic of Father Winter, this version has been adapted to specifically target the Acolyte Mouse.
> Vulnerable to those magics long forgotten, any Acolyte Mouse that is caught with this device is immediately drained of all power which is then used to increase the power of the trap itself!
> The Chrono Mouse is the only one powerful enough to rewind the timepiece and release all of the stored Acolyte power from the trap.
> The power from the timepiece was originally used to create toys, trinkets and other gifts as well as keep Father Winter on track to deliver all the presents. Upon releasing the stored Acolyte power, this trap uses it to create bonus loot for each Acolyte that was caught.
> Although it's referred to as a timepiece, the only time it tells is that the Acolyte Mouse's time is up!
> This Timepiece Trap gains a power bonus for each Acolyte Mouse it captures while armed inside the Acolyte Realm. This power bonus only works while inside the Acolyte Realm. Capturing a Chrono Mouse will release all of the contained bonus Acolyte power, causing the trap to generate a piece of loot for each Acolyte it captured!

> The warm glow seems so inviting until a mouse gets too close...

# ⚔️ Polar Vortex Trap

> **Entity**: Equipment | **Element**: Tactical | **Rank**: Baron/Baroness

> **Classification**: Tactical Weapon  
> **Power / Luck**: 8,000 Power | 30 Luck  
> **Title Requirement**: Baron/Baroness  
> **Acquisition Cost**: 0

## 📜 Lore & Rekayasa Perangkap

> This severe swirling snowstorm is a large-scale extratropical cyclone that occurs when the raging forces contained within Cyclone Stones are released into an atmospheric zone that has a high concentration of holiday magic. These festive forces produce an inescapable vortex that pull mice into its centre and trap them forever. Once inside, most mice are quite content to be trapped because the eye of this storm is actually a calm and cheerful place where the snow is always ideal for packing and the surrounding rushing winds sound like merry melodies.

# ⚔️ Ronza's Flock of Golden Anti-Dragonbots

> **Entity**: Equipment | **Element**: Draconic | **Rank**: Recruit

> **Classification**: Draconic Weapon  
> **Power / Luck**: 5,700 Power | 12 Luck  
> **Title Requirement**: Recruit  
> **Acquisition Cost**: 50 Dragonhide Sliver

## 📜 Lore & Rekayasa Perangkap

> The year was 2024 when the great dragon invasion ascended from the Draconic Depths and took to the skies in a malevolent attempt to stop Ronza from aiding the MouseHunters of Gnawnia.
> She had discovered the latest plot devised by the notorious Mythweaver and was on her way to the Kingdom to prepare them for the upcoming threat. However, as soon as her ship crossed into Gnawnian airspace, she was attacked by waves of dragons who had escaped the Draconic Depths and collected like-minded minions along their way. She was first attacked by Ice Dragons, followed by Poison Dragons, and finally a wave of ferocious Fire Dragons who bolstered their numbers by gathering their cousins from the Queso Geyser. At the sight of these horrid, winged beasts, there was a moment of utter despair as Ronza truly felt that all was lost.
> But alas, just in the nick of time, the heroic MouseHunters of Gnawnia descended upon those sinister serpents in defence of their beloved Ronza! They traveled en masse from all corners of the known world to meet these formidable foes face-to-face and to show them the might, determination, and unity of the great Kingdom of Gnawnia. An epic battle ensued over the course of three long weeks where the skill and ingenuity of the MouseHunters was put to the test as they had to gather strange and exotic cheeses to lure these dastardly dragons away from Ronza's airship and directly into their traps. Along the way, the hunters were able to accumulate a curious collection of loot that had never yet been seen on the surface world.
> The MouseHunters were at last victorious in their valiant efforts and thus Ronza was able to complete her mission. She successfully delivered the fabled Tale of the First Dragons that would lead the brave hunters onto their next, and possibly most dangerous, adventure into the Draconic Depths!
> While the MouseHunters were bravely defending her airship, Ronza was afforded enough time to build a draconic defence of her own. She took all the gold that hunters had spent at her shoppe that year, melted it down, and used it to forge a fierce, fighting flock of Golden Anti-Dragonbots! Each Anti-Dragonbot was equipped with a fearsome laser beam that was powered by the mysterious Dragonhide Slivers that the attacking dragons had carried up with them from the Draconic Depths. With this new, state-of-the-art defence system, Ronza ensured that her flights would never again be troubled by the dreadful Dragons of the Depths.
> As a heartfelt thank you to the MouseHunters who saved her, Ronza offered them all a parting gift that was an exact replica of this mighty new draconic defence system. They merely needed to provide the Dragonhide Slivers to power it and it was theirs to keep. As she flew off into the sunset once again, she bid them all a fond farewell and wished them the best of luck with their next daunting duty of descending into the dark and dismal den from which those dreadful, destructive dragons derived: the Draconic Depths!
> Thus was the tale of Dragons' Ascent: The Battle for Ronza's Airship.

## 🔨 Asal-Usul & Perakitan (Crafting/Shoppe)
The Ronza's Flock of Golden Anti-Dragonbots is available for purchase for 50 Dragonhide Sliver from Ronza's Shoppe.

It cannot be refunded.

# 📍 Bountiful Beanstalk

> **Entity**: Location | **Region**: Folklore Forest

> **Wilayah / Region**: Folklore Forest  
> **Pangkat Minimal**: Recruit  
> **Fasilitas Lokal**: Cheese ShoppeTrapsmithCharm ShoppeGeneral StoreCartographer

## 🌍 Gambaran & Atmosfer Lingkungan

Bountiful Beanstalk is a hunting location in the Folklore Forest region.

Hunters require a minimum Rank of Viceroy and the Tale of the Bountiful Beanstalk to access.

Hunters start off by looting Magic Beans on the Beanstalk to purchase Beanster Cheese. After catching Vinneus Stalkhome and looting 1 Fabled Fertilizer, Hunters can plant a vine up the beanstalk to enter The Castle in the Clouds.
There are 3 floors within the Castle, the Dungeon Floor, the Ballroom Floor, and the Great Hall Floor, each of which contain rooms that provide different primary loots.
Hunters are able to primarily loot Magic Beans and Lavish Lapis Beans in the Dungeon Floor, Royal Ruby Beans and Golden Harp Strings in the Ballroom Floor, and Golden Goose Eggs in the Great Hall Floor.
Hunters are able to collect Fabled Fertilizers from multiple Vinneus Stalkhome catches, and Giants at the end of each Castle floor.

Golden Harp Strings, Magic Beans, Lavish Lapis Beans, and Royal Ruby Beans earned within the rooms can be used to purchase different type of cheese in Bountiful Beanstalk.
Fabled Fertilizers earned can be used to plant vines to the Dungeon Floor, Ballroom Floor, or Great Hall Floor.

# 📍 Dojo

> **Entity**: Location | **Region**: Furoma

> **Wilayah / Region**: Furoma  
> **Pangkat Minimal**: Grandmaster  
> **Fasilitas Lokal**: Cheese ShoppeTrapsmithCharm ShoppeGeneral Store

## 🌍 Gambaran & Atmosfer Lingkungan

The Dojo is a location in the Furoma region requiring a minimum rank of Grandmaster and the Stitched Furoma Map Piece to enter.
The Stitched Furoma Map Piece can only be obtained by taking the Shredded Furoma Map Piece found in the Mousoleum to the Cartographer in the Bazaar for repair.

## 🗣️ Nasihat & Pesan dari Larry the Knight

> "Welcome to the Dojo, where students of the three Furoma schools train. Catch one of these students, and there is a very good chance they will drop one of their school's tokens, which are vital in the creation of three very special forms of cheese. Read the descriptions of the tokens you collect for cheese-crafting clues. There are also rumors that one of Plankrun's Journal Pages can be found in the Dojo, which may hold some interesting information about cheese recipes.

One of the Furoma students' weaknesses is Maki cheese. You can make Maki by smashing three pieces of SUPER|brie+ with your Hunter’s Hammer then combining them with three Curds and Whey and one piece of Nori.

Confused about crafting or how to make cheese? You can read the research of your fellow hunters in the MouseHunt Wiki for more help.

Once you've collected tokens and made new types of cheese, you'll want to head to the Meditation Room where you can hunt the masters. I have a suspicion that the incredibly dangerous Assassin mice may be in the Dojo on a hunting mission of their own. Catching one these mice may reveal clues on better ways to combat the forces of Furoma."

# 📍 Fiery Warpath

> **Entity**: Location | **Region**: Sandtail Desert

> **Wilayah / Region**: Sandtail Desert  
> **Pangkat Minimal**: Baron/Baroness  
> **Fasilitas Lokal**: Cheese ShoppeTrapsmithCharm ShoppeGeneral StoreCartographer

## 🌍 Gambaran & Atmosfer Lingkungan

The Fiery Warpath is a location in the Sandtail Desert region requiring a minimum rank of Baron/Baroness and a Sandtail Call to Arms to enter, which can be obtained as a reward for completing the Capture the Mystic and Technic Kings Adventure in the Seasonal Garden and Zugzwang's Tower.

## 🗣️ Nasihat & Pesan dari Larry the Knight

> "The Marching Flame are preparing to invade Gnawnia. Their Fiery Warpath to the castle has reached a standoff in the Sandtail Desert where you must hold them back at all costs! These mice are highly organized, you must defeat each wave before progressing to the next.

Capturing the same type of mouse multiple times in a row will demoralize the troops, causing that type to regroup off the battlefield. The higher your streak, the more will retreat. Capturing a Crimson Commander while having a high streak will cause even more to retreat as they carry the commands throughout the battalion.

The King has stocked a Charm Shoppe that will help you achieve these high streaks and outmanoeuvre your enemy. The Marching Flame is equally prepared, though. Failing to capture Caravan Guard Mice will allow reinforcements to arrive. According to the King's scouts, SUPER|brie+ is known to attract more Crimson Commanders and fewer Caravan Guards.

Within the fourth and final wave is their leader, a Warmonger Mouse. Be warned that although the Warmonger Mouse can be encountered at any time during this wave, they will be immune to capture until you have defeated all of the Theurgy Warden Mice that guard them. When you succeed in catching a Warmonger Mouse, the rewards will be great. However, after capturing your first, the Warmongers will be keen to your threat and will guard their loot more closely.

Best of luck hunter! No victory is too small and no defeat is too great. One mouse or one hunter could turn the tide of the war. Gnawnia needs you to succeed!"

# 📍 Floating Islands

> **Entity**: Location | **Region**: Hollow Heights

> **Wilayah / Region**: Hollow Heights  
> **Pangkat Minimal**: Archduke/Archduchess  
> **Fasilitas Lokal**: Cheese ShoppeTrapsmithCharm ShoppeGeneral StoreCartographer

## 🌍 Gambaran & Atmosfer Lingkungan

Floating Islands is a Location located within the Hollow Heights Region, requiring a minimum Rank of Archduke/Archduchess and the Dirigible and Flight License Map Piece to access.

Floating Islands makes use of 8 different Power Types, nearly every available one in the game, namely:

- Arcane
- Forgotten
- Hydro
- Shadow
- Draconic
- Law
- Physical
- Tactical

Mice here are able to pillage Standard Cheese, Points and Gold if one fails to capture them.

Hunters first collect Cloud Curd to purchase Cloud Cheesecake while at the Launch Pad. All 8 Power Types are effective here.
Subsequently, Hunters fly towards specific Power Type Islands to hunt mice using their Sky Map.
There are 2 versions of each Island, Low Altitude and High Altitude: Hunters must first clear a minimum of 4 Low Altitude Islands and defeat 4 different Wardens to unlock a single High Altitude Island.
While hunting on the islands, mice will drop loot used to upgrade your Skyfarer's Oculus, customise your Dirigible and obtain new Traps.

When Hunters have completed the Explore the Floating Islands Adventure, they can proceed to purchase the High Altitude Flight License from the Cartographer.
Together with 500 Sky Glass and 500 Sky Ore, Hunters can then attach Rocket Boosters onto their Dirigible.
These boosters enable Paragons, Pirates and Richard the Rich in both Low Altitude and High Altitude islands to drop Storm Cells.
Once the Hunter has collected 50 Storm Cells, they can be spent on the Launch Console while at the Launch Pad to journey to the Empyrean Sky Palace instead of a regular island.
The Empyrean Sky Palace consists of different Power Type Vaults which have mice that drop greater amounts of loot as compared to those obtained on regular islands.

## 🗣️ Nasihat & Pesan dari Larry the Knight

> "Welcome to the Floating Islands where you can finally see the world from Ronza's perspective!

Now that you've got your flight license, the sky is the limit! The King has commissioned the construction of this luxurious Launch Pad (it took a lot of tariffs to pull this one off!) as a home for hunters who are taking to the skies to capture the mice above the clouds!

Here you will find a new type of building: the Workshop. It can be used to upgrade your Skyfarer's Oculus and customize your dirigible. You can also find the usual assortment of shops which will be crucial in providing much needed bait, trap upgrades, and some special supplies for sailing the skies!

The Cheese Shoppe has been stocked with a delicious new cheesy treat that is so light and fluffy that it defies the laws of physics! I suggest loading up on at least 75 pieces for your first trip to the islands.

The Charm Shoppe has some pretty powerful charms for sale so it's worth a visit for the veteran Floating Islander.

The Trapsmith should be one of your first stops so you can see what new wonders of the mouse catching world are available for purchase as well as what resources they require from the various islands above.

Now, before you go rushing off to hit that shiny new "Start" button, let me share the intel we've gathered so far about how the islands seem to work.

Upon opening your Sky Map, you will see the current layout of islands available to you as well as Markers indicating unique spots that are located on each one. Each island is also home to a specific group of mice that are weak to the power type indicated on the axis of the Sky Map grid. Remember, the winds of change are constantly blowing, after each island you explore, the Sky Map will change and a new set of islands will appear so don't take this decision lightly!

An island with a shrine on it will also be home to one of the four Wardens. These Wardens prevent travel to the High Altitude islands which are home to the most powerful mice and rarest resources. You will need to capture all four Wardens before your Sky Map will reveal the High Altitude islands. Make sure to gather as many resources as possible along the way so that you will be well prepared to battle the powerful guardians of the High Altitude islands: the Paragons!

After selecting an island and pressing "Launch", you will set sail in your dirigible and land at your destination. Upon landing, make sure to adjust your trap setup to the power type of that island. To make this easier, your dirigible has been equipped with a brand new Trap Library that you can use to save your complete setup for each power type. Once you've saved it, that setup will equip automatically every time you visit an island with that power type! This fancy new feature should help to make your island voyages much smoother! Once you've landed and equipped your setup, you can begin exploring these miraculous places! Be careful though, you only have 75 hunts before the island floats too far away from the Launch Pad thus preventing a safe return. If you exceed this limit, your crew will automatically pack everything up and take you back to the Launch Pad. So, make every hunt count!

Each successful catch on the island will progress your exploration bar but each time you fail to catch, the enemy mice on the other side of the island will make progress towards you!
If you are successful enough to enter a special area of the island, you will immediately gain its bonus for the remainder of your hunts. However, the mice are exploring it as well but they are looking for you! If you meet up with that enemy hoard and there is a shrine on the island, it will be the Warden that leads the charge! Once you meet a Warden, you won't be able to attract any other mice until you either catch it or are forced off the island!

Fully exploring an area of the island will fortify its location which means the opposing mice cannot push you back any further.

Well, I guess that's it -- oh wait, I almost forgot! There have been reports of Sky Pirates roaming the skies in this region so be extra vigilant in your expeditions!

The rest is up to you. Good luck, hunter!

Wow... what a view! To think, I almost missed out on this due to my crippling fear of heights!"

## ⚠️ Bahaya Lingkungan & Mekanik Wilayah
The HUD always shows the Following Items:

- Hunter's inventory of Cloud Curd
- Hunter's inventory of Cloud Cheesecake
- Hunter's inventory of Extra Rich Cloud Cheesecake
- Hunter's inventory of Sky Ore
- Hunter's inventory of Sky Glass
- Hunter's inventory of Corsair's Curd
- Hunter's inventory of Sky Pirate Swiss Cheese
- Number of Sky Wardens remaining

Hunters can configure their Skyfarer's Satchel to show following items:

- Hunter's inventory of Bottled Wind
- Hunter's inventory of Cyclone Stone
- Hunter's inventory of Sky Sprocket
- Hunter's inventory of Skysoft Silk
- Hunter's inventory of Enchanted Wing
- Hunter's inventory of Cloudstone Bangle
- Hunter's inventory of Sky Pirate Seal
- Hunter's inventory of Raw Ancient Jade (available once hunter completes Explore the Floating Islands adventure)
- Hunter's inventory of Empyrean Seal (available once hunter completes Explore the Floating Islands adventure)
- Hunter's inventory of Adorned Empyrean Jewel (available once hunter completes Explore the Floating Islands adventure)
- Hunter's inventory of Storm Cell (available once hunter completes Explore the Floating Islands adventure)
- Hunter's inventory of Low Altitude Treasure...

# 📍 Forbidden Grove

> **Entity**: Location | **Region**: Bristle Woods

> **Wilayah / Region**: Bristle Woods  
> **Pangkat Minimal**: Legendary  
> **Fasilitas Lokal**: Cheese ShoppeTrapsmithCharm ShoppeGeneral Store

## 🌍 Gambaran & Atmosfer Lingkungan

The Forbidden Grove is a location in the Bristle Woods region requiring a minimum rank of Legendary and the Keeper's Candle to enter. In addition, the Forbidden Grove must be open for Hunters to access the location.
The Keeper's Candle can be acquired by capturing a Keeper Mouse in the Catacombs.
Mice in the Forbidden Grove may steal points, gold, or multiple pieces of cheese if not captured.

The Forbidden Grove acts as a gateway to the Acolyte Realm. Hunters may not entered the Acolyte Realm without first catching a Realm Ripper Mouse in the Forbidden Grove.

## 🗣️ Nasihat & Pesan dari Larry the Knight

> "Only the most capable MouseHunters make it to the Forbidden Grove! I'm impressed.

This area may look like a garden, but it is actually a giant trap designed to catch the powerful Acolyte mouse! Every few hours the massive stone gates close, sealing this area off from the Catacombs. When the gates close, a thick fog fills the grove and anyone still inside will be transported into the Acolyte Realm upon capturing a Realm Ripper Mouse.

The mice here are weak to Arcane traps and are highly attracted to Ancient Cheese. To make Ancient Cheese, combine three Stale cheese with six Ionized Salt. You can also add three Magic Essence to the same recipe to double the amount of cheese produced.

The mice within this grove are trying to reverse the effects of the portal to keep a two-way gate open at all times. Should they accomplish this goal, armies of mice will soon invade Gnawnia at the command of the evil Acolyte!

Be on the look out for magical runes dropped by the mice here. Runes are used to craft Runic cheese, which is the only cheese capable of attracting an Acolyte.

Remember that when the gates close, Realm Ripper mice will be in the grove. If you capture a Realm Ripper, you will be transported to the Acolyte Realm. Keep this fact in mind before leaving your trap for long periods of time."

# 📍 Fort Rox

> **Entity**: Location | **Region**: Varmint Valley

> **Wilayah / Region**: Varmint Valley  
> **Pangkat Minimal**: Baron/Baroness  
> **Fasilitas Lokal**: Cheese ShoppeTrapsmithCharm ShoppeGeneral StoreCartographer

## 🌍 Gambaran & Atmosfer Lingkungan

Fort Rox is a hunting location in Varmint Valley region.

It requires the minimum Rank of Baron/Baroness and the Fort Rox Battle Summons to access.

There are 5 defensive features in this area:

- The Wall determines the Hunter's survivability during Night and Dawn.
- The Ballista improves the catch rate against Weremice and Nightmancer.
- The Cannon improves the catch rate against Cosmic Critter and Nightfire.
- The Moat reduces damage to the Wall.
- The Mage Tower provides various effects to hunting and progressing in this area.

There are 4 phases in this area:

- During Day, the Hunter can collect Meteorite Piece, repair Wall and upgrade Fort.
- During Night, the Hunter can collect Howlite and Bloodstone to upgrade Fort when return to Day.
- During Dawn, the Hunter can collect Dawn Dust to purchase Map Piece for the next area as well as to access a harder challenge in Fort Rox.
- During Heart of the Meteor, the Hunter can hunt for Meteoric Core Fragments, which is required to purchase a new Law weapon in the Trapsmith.

## 🌍 Gambaran & Atmosfer Lingkungan

Gnawnia Rift is a hunting location in Rift Plane region.

It requires the minimum rank of Count/Countess and the Rift Detector to access.

This is the first area to make use of Rift power type in the game.

The Hunter need to use String Cheese to attract mice that carry Riftiago Potion. Riftiago Cheese brew from that Potion can attract mice that drop materials to craft Resonator Cheese, which is required to attract the Goliath Field Mouse. A Rift trap is far more effective against mice in Gnawnia Rift as well as later areas in Rift Plane compared to other power type.

# 📍 Gnawnian Express Station

> **Entity**: Location | **Region**: Varmint Valley

> **Wilayah / Region**: Varmint Valley  
> **Pangkat Minimal**: Lord/Lady  
> **Fasilitas Lokal**: Cheese ShoppeTrapsmithCharm ShoppeGeneral Store

## 🌍 Gambaran & Atmosfer Lingkungan

The Gnawnian Express Station is a location in the Varmint Valley region requiring a minimum rank of Lord/Lady and the Whisker Woods Clearing Map Piece to enter. Mice are unable to steal a Hunter's supplies in the Gnawnian Express Station.

Law weapons are required to capture the mice found in this location.

In the Gnawnian Express Station, Hunters can board trains and defend them as they travel through 3 stages: Supply Depot, Raider River, and Daredevil Canyon. When not aboard a train, Hunters are in the Train Station.

Each stage of the train requires a different strategy and has weapons and charms that provide special effects. Mice in each section vary and provide specific loot drops required for obtaining the weapons that provide special effects in the Gnawnian Express Station. Each phase of the train has the same duration, equal to 1/3 of the total Trip Time.

Hunters can earn points by completing certain tasks during each phase of the train. Rewards given to Hunters are dependant upon the points earned by Hunters and their team and by the collective points earned by all teams aboard a train.

The Gnawnian Express Station requires more interaction from Hunters than many other locations. Each phase has specific weapons and charms necessary to take full advantage of the area, requiring Hunters to actively manage these items while aboard a train. Acquiring Royal Supply Crates, Raider-B-Gone Mouse Repellent, and Fuel Nuggets as loot does not aid the team's score unless Hunters choose to submit them through the HUD.

Because trains use the same scheduling mechanic as Tournaments, Hunters must form (or join) a team (though they do not need to add any team members) to board trains. Hunters may not be in a Tournament at the same time they are aboard a train. Hunters may only schedule 1 train at a time. This also means that Hunters are limited to scheduling no more than 1 train and 2 Tournaments at any time.

# 📍 Harbour

> **Entity**: Location | **Region**: Gnawnia

> **Wilayah / Region**: Gnawnia  
> **Pangkat Minimal**: Initiate  
> **Fasilitas Lokal**: Cheese ShoppeTrapsmithGeneral StoreCartographer

## 🌍 Gambaran & Atmosfer Lingkungan

The Harbour is a location in the Gnawnia region requiring a minimum rank of Initiate to enter.
The Harbour is the first area Hunters will access where mice can steal gold, points, or extra cheese and where they can visit a Cartographer and purchase a Treasure Map.

Hunters accessing the Harbour for the first time will only have access to Physical weapons, but the mice here have a weakness to all Power Types, except the Pirate Mouse, Barmy Gunner, Bilged Boatswain, Cabin Boy, Corrupt Commodore, and Dashing Buccaneer which have a weakness only to Hydro, Physical and Tactical weapons.

Hunters must capture a Pirate Mouse to obtain a pirate bounty. When Hunters begin the search for the mice listed on the crew manifest provided by the Pirate Mouse, the Pirate Crew mice are added to the mouse population of the Harbour. Capturing all 3 mice listed on the crew manifest will reward the player with booty from the pirate bounty. Hunters must claim 5 Pirate Bounties which each reward A Map Scrap used to complete the Calm Clearing Map Piece.

## 🗣️ Nasihat & Pesan dari Larry the Knight

> "Welcome to the Harbour, MouseHunter! I just love that cool breeze that comes in off the ocean, don’t you?

The mice in this area are a little bit cheekier than those found in Town of Gnawnia or the Meadow. They may just steal some of your points or gold if you fail to catch them.

If you need to upgrade your trap or purchase more cheese, check out the many shops featured in the Harbour! If you’re in the market for a new trap, may I recommend a Rocketine trap or Mouse Trebuchet?

Be on the lookout for the dangerous pirate crews that are raiding the Harbour! Pirate mice are rumored to be carrying Map Scraps that could lead you to a new area. Capture a Pirate Mouse to reveal and capture their crew manifest and recover the Map Scraps, and then combine them to add a new hunting location to your map!

When you reach the next title of Journeyman/Journeywoman, you'll be able to move to another hunting ground. View your map to see what locations you have discovered.

Happy hunting!"

## 🗣️ Nasihat & Pesan dari Larry the Knight

> "The waters of the Lagoon look dangerous! I hope you can swim!

You will find yourself having trouble attracting mice to your trap here, unless you use Gnarled cheese. If you need more Gnarled cheese, head back to the Great Gnarled Tree to collect potions from the mice there. Or, if you want to attract the really valuable mice here, you might want to make some Wicked Gnarly Cheese. MouseHunters pursuing this cheese might benefit from consulting a certain Curious Chemist at the Great Gnarled Tree about ingredients.

Dwelling in the water is the fearsome Hydra mouse. The Hydra originates from the Ocean to the East, where it is known for being the cause of many shipwrecks. For this reason, the Hydra is known for dropping many nautical items. If you are equipped with a Hydro or Tactical trap, try hunting the Hydra. You may just discover the mysteries of the ocean in the process."

# 📍 Mountain

> **Entity**: Location | **Region**: Gnawnia

> **Wilayah / Region**: Gnawnia  
> **Pangkat Minimal**: Journeyman

## 🗣️ Nasihat & Pesan dari Larry the Knight

> "Welcome, Mousehunter! You're about to discover the stunning vistas and treacherous terrain of the glorious Gnawnian Mountain! Home to Moustachio the Charmer, he has come up with these clever trinkets called charms that you can use to bolster your trap in many different ways. Don't forget to visit the Charm Shoppe to pick up your very own Charm Conduit to be able to use these new charms.

The Gold and Diamond mice found here are worth a handsome amount of gold and points. Extra income means that you may now be able to afford more expensive cheeses and more powerful traps. Don’t be afraid to upgrade your trap at the Trapsmith or purchase some more expensive cheese if you have problems attracting or catching mice. You’ve earned it!

Now, be careful while exploring the Mountain. Upon these rocky precipices lies excitement, danger and big boulders full of tasty Chedd-Ore Cheese deposits just waiting to be mined. Hunt mice in the area to gather up various types of Power Charms. Once equipped, the power released from the charms will vibrate the rock face and cause the boulders to crumble and shatter, revealing Chedd-Ore Cheese! Using this cheese will attract the harder-to-find mice which live within the Mountain itself. Capturing them will drop crafting items that can be used to lure out the large, mysterious Abominable Snow Mouse who lives high up on the Mountain! If you can find a way to capture him, he could lead you to the next prosperous area!"

The Hunter collects Key Shards here to craft Zugzwang's Tower Key to unlock Zugzwang's Tower location.

# 📍 Sunken City

> **Entity**: Location | **Region**: Rodentia

> **Wilayah / Region**: Rodentia  
> **Pangkat Minimal**: Count/Countess  
> **Fasilitas Lokal**: Cheese ShoppeTrapsmithCharm ShoppeGeneral StoreCartographer

## 🌍 Gambaran & Atmosfer Lingkungan

The Sunken City is a location in the Rodentia region requiring a minimum rank of Count/Countess and the Sunken Souvenir to enter. Mice in this location may steal points, gold, or multiple pieces of cheese if not captured.

The Sunken Souvenir can be purchased from the Muridae Market Cartographer for 228,000 gold and 90 Molten Glass.

To begin hunting in the Sunken City, Hunters must gather Oxygen Canisters from mice encountered while Docked. Hunters will need a minimum of 10 Oxygen Canisters to Dive and the more Oxygen Canisters Hunters have, the longer they will be able to stay submerged. While on a Dive Hunters can gather the ingredients necessary for crafting Fishy Fromage. Fishy Fromage will only attract mice while Docked and allows the attraction of mice that drop greater numbers of Oxygen Canisters.

The Sunken City mice are all a part of the Deep Sea Dwellers group and are divided into seven subgroups: Barnacled Bunch, Coral Corral, Finned Fiend, Predator Pack, Scale Society, Sunken City Citizens, and Treasure Troop. Sunken City mice are weak only to Hydro weapons.

Hunters may leave the Sunken City without losing progress on a Dive.

## 🗣️ Nasihat & Pesan dari Larry the Knight

> "Welcome to the Sunken City! A civilization lost long ago to the depths of the ocean. Now, overrun with mice, they have taken over and restored functionality to use as a secret base of underwater operations. Using advanced submarine science, it looks like they have been trying to recruit the aquatic mice and gather underwater resources.

The King needs you to use one of these submerging sea shuttles and explore the deep sea to see how far the reach of the Sunken City goes and to stop those mice waiting to strike from the sea!

Before you can begin a dive, you'll need to collect some Oxygen Canisters by hunting in the city. Once you have some Oxygen Canisters saved up, begin a dive! While exploring the ocean floor you'll find ingredients to craft the valuable Fishy Fromage: a bait the mice in the Sunken City find especially tempting!

The ahem, "unique" smell of Fishy Fromage can't quite stink while underwater, so avoid arming any while diving. Instead, use it at the Sunken City where you'll attract a greater number of mice that drop oxygen! If you manage your resources well, you may find that you're better able to resupply yourself after each dive, so dive early, and dive often!

The further away from the city you get, the more valuable treasures you're likely to find. However, far away from the city are also where the most powerful predators lie, so be careful!"

# 📍 Town of Digby

> **Entity**: Location | **Region**: Burroughs

> **Wilayah / Region**: Burroughs  
> **Pangkat Minimal**: Master  
> **Fasilitas Lokal**: Cheese ShoppeTrapsmithCharm ShoppeGeneral StoreCartographer

## 🌍 Gambaran & Atmosfer Lingkungan

The Town of Digby is a location in the Burroughs region requiring a minimum rank of Master and the Key to the Town of Digby to enter.
Mice in the Town of Digby cannot steal gold, points, or cheese.
Cheese usage determines the mice population in the Town of Digby. One grouping of mice is available when Standard Cheese or SUPER|brie+ is armed. When Limelight Cheese is armed, Hunters can encounter the Digby Dirt Dwellers mice.

## 🗣️ Nasihat & Pesan dari Larry the Knight

> "Congratulations on finding the secret research facility of Digby!

After the Laboratory was overrun with mice, the scientists fled here. Unfortunately, it did not take the mice long to find it. The scientists now need your help hunting down the intruders!

Be sure to visit the Trapsmith in Digby to view its experimental traps. You will notice an extremely powerful trap called the DrillBot, which is a crucial part in upgrading to a more powerful Physical trap setup.

Digby seems to be the perfect environment for the rare Mole Mouse. If you have yet to discover this breed, hunting for it here may be worth your while.

Recent tunnelling by town officials has also uncovered some construction mice, who appear to be digging a tunnel of their own. Along with these new intruders, the Town of Digby now has to deal with the worm-like Big Bad Burroughs mice, and their smaller cousins, the Itty-Bitty Burroughs mice.

Anyone wanting to catch these new subterranean breeds should use Limelight Cheese, which is made from Radioactive Sludge, Curds and Whey and Living Shards. Living Shards are available at the Digby General Store.

Hunting the Big Bad Burroughs mouse is risky, but could pay off big. Digby scientists report that a Big Bad Burroughs mouse ran off with a rare slab of Ohnoesium ore the other day, and I've heard that Ohnoesium can be very valuable to hunters..."

The Town of Gnawnia is a location in the Gnawnia region requiring a minimum rank of Recruit to enter.
Mice in the Town of Gnawnia cannot steal gold, points, or extra cheese.
Hunters accessing the Town of Gnawnia for the first time will only have access to Physical weapons, but the mice here have a weakness to all Power Types.

## 🗣️ Nasihat & Pesan dari Larry the Knight

> "Welcome to the Town of Gnawnia, home of His Majesty, the King!

The town has been overrun by a rowdy band of mice, and the King is offering up bounty rewards for their capture! A good MouseHunter will be sure to bait their trap using one of the bounty target's preferred varieties of cheese to increase their chances of success in the hunt.

Gnawnia has two shops. The first is the Cheese Shoppe where you can buy bait for your trap, and the second is the Trapsmith, where you can buy new trap parts.

When you reach the title of Apprentice, you may want to try hunting at the Windmill. Visit the Travel page to access your map and travel to other hunting grounds."

## ⚠️ Bahaya Lingkungan & Mekanik Wilayah
The Heads-Up Display in the Town of Gnawnia tracks the bounties available to Hunters. Hunters can collect bounties on six mice.

Collecting bounties is completely optional, but doing so allows Hunters to also complete the Secure the Town of Gnawnia adventure in the Adventure Book.

When first entering the Town of Gnawnia, the HUD will show a mouse silhouette and Bounties Available!. It also shows Likes: and Loves: for the cheese preference, but without any cheese specified.

# 📍 Valour Rift

> **Pangkat Minimal**: Archduke/Archduchess

## 🌍 Gambaran & Atmosfer Lingkungan

Valour Rift is a location within the Rift Plane. Hunters collect Gauntlet Elixir while arming String Cheese when they first arrive, using them to exchange for/craft Gauntlet String Cheese. After stockpiling sufficient Gauntlet String Cheese, hunters can enter the tower. Before entering the tower, there are 6 different augmentations one can activate in exchange for gold and materials looted from within the tower. The Ultimate Umbra augmentation is required for encountering The Total Eclipse, which drops Core of the Eclipse. Otherwise, Shade of the Eclipse is encountered instead. As hunters attempt more runs and reach higher floors, the augmentations are unlocked and they can upgrade their Speed, Sync and Siphon. This helps make subsequent runs more manageable.

Using Champion's Fire while hunting will add +1 loot for Elixirs, Sigils, Secrets, Fragments, Cores, and Skin Patterns when found. While in the tower, it will also boost +1 step each catch.Champion's Fire is consumed every hunt.

## ⚠️ Bahaya Lingkungan & Mekanik Wilayah
The HUD tracks the Following Items:

- Hunter's inventory of Gauntlet Elixir
- Hunter's inventory of Gauntlet String Cheese
- Hunter's inventory of Marble String Cheese
- Hunter's inventory of Swiss String Cheese
- Hunter's inventory of Brie String Cheese
- Hunter's inventory of Magical String Cheese
- Hunter's inventory of Champion's Fire
- Hunter's inventory of Tower Sigils
- Hunter's inventory of Tower Secrets
- Hunter's inventory of Fragments of the Eclipse
- Hunter's inventory of Cores of the Eclipse
- Hunter's Hunts left - Amount of hunts remaining before being expelled from the tower.
- Hunter's Step - This represents the current step you're on and how high you've ascended the tower in this climb.

Gauntlet String Cheese can be bought or crafted directly from the HUD.

While inside the tower, Hunters will see their player icon in a circular crop on steps headed upwards. Circular icons of in-game friends indicate their current step while square icon indicates their highest step reached. 
On browser, an expanded view can be seen by clicking the magnifying glass icon.
There is an option to retreat.

# 📍 Whisker Woods Rift

> **Entity**: Location | **Region**: Rift Plane

> **Wilayah / Region**: Rift Plane  
> **Pangkat Minimal**: Duke/Duchess  
> **Fasilitas Lokal**: CartographerCharm ShoppeCheese ShoppeGeneral StoreTrapsmith

## 🌍 Gambaran & Atmosfer Lingkungan

The Whisker Woods Rift is a location in the Rift Plane region requiring a minimum rank of Duke/Duchess and the Rift Detector to enter.

The main gameplay for this area consists in generating Rage levels among the mice, to attract better mice.
There are three factions of mice in the area: Crazed Clearing, Gigantic Gnarled Tree, and Deep Lagoon.
Each faction has 8 mice:

- 3 that are attracted when the rage level for their faction is between 0 and 24 (each catch raises the rage level by 1)
- 3 that are attracted for rage levels of 25 through 49 (each catch raises the rage level by 2, unless it would go past 50)
- 1 mini-boss that is only attracted when the rage has reached 50
- 1 mouse that is only attracted when the correct charm is armed regardless of current rage level (raises the rage level by up to 6, unless it would go past 50)

Catching a mouse leaves a message in the Hunter's Journal:

Catching a Gilded Leaf mouse (attracted only to Magical String) raises the rage level of all three factions by 2 each, with this message:

If a faction-specific charm is used, the increase in rage will go to the charm's faction rather than the faction of the caught mouse, altering the message as follows:

The faction-specific charms can be crafted with loot dropped by any of the mice (although the loot is more common with the harder mice); the loot and charms can also be traded at the Marketplace.

Hitting 25 rage leaves a message specific to the faction:

- Crazed Clearing

- Gigantic Gnarled Tree

- Deep Lagoon

Hitting 50 rage leaves a message specific to the faction:

- Crazed Clearing

- Gigantic Gnarled Tree

- Deep Lagoon

When catching a mini-boss, the rage levels of all three factions are reset to 0, with a message specific to the faction:

- Crazed Clearing

- Gigantic Gnarled Tree

- Deep Lagoon

Each mini-boss drops a crafting ingredient required for Lactrodectus Lancashire cheese.
Trying to use this cheese before all factions are enraged gives a warning message that the cheese is not effective:

Once the rage of all three factions are at least 25, the Monstrous Black Widow can be attracted with the Lactrodectus Lancashire cheese.
The chances for attracting her are higher with higher rage levels.
Catching her rewards the Hunter with a variety of loot depending on the number of factions at 50 rage; see the mouse page for more details.
Catching her resets the rage levels of all three factions to 0, with this message:

A Taunting Charm can be used to maintain high rage levels even after catching a mini-boss or the Monstrous Black Widow, with this message:

## 🗣️ Nasihat & Pesan dari Larry the Knight

> "Just listen to all that noise!

Three distinct groups of mice live in this area, and they're always arguing amongst themselves! Amidst the madness, the Monstrous Black Widow Mouse makes this her home, so if you want to catch her, you'll have to brave the shouting and get sucked in!

As you catch mice from a group in this area, it will enrage mice from that group more and more. As the rage in each group rises, some mice will squeak "I'm telling!" and run to go get larger mice from their group to stand in for them!

The only way to stop this madness is to push a group to the limit, drawing out their biggest, baddest challenger.

Defeat this raging monster, and all of the awestruck mice in the area will run away in fear, forgetting their rage for a while...

You'll also be rewarded with valuable crafting ingredients for your efforts. Keep them safe! You'll need them to lure out the elusive Monstrous Black Widow Mouse!

Sound tricky? It is! Here's a tip: Visit your Crafting Recipe Book and you'll find formulas useful in figuring out which buttons to push. When you have the right cheese and all the mice are angry, she is bound to show up!

Hunt well and hunt bravely! The mice might look really scary, and they really are, but don't be afraid! The worst you can do is get them angry and riled up, right?"

Zugzwang's Tower is a hunting location in Rodentia region.

Mice here become available under certain conditions.

Amplifier modifies power and luck, thus greatly affects the Hunter's ability to catch mice here.

Each trip can be a single or double run. After each run, the Hunter need to charge the amplifier in Seasonal Garden again before doing the next run.

Hunters must complete the Capture the Mystic and Technic Kings Adventure to obtain the Sandtail Call to Arms, which is necessary to gain access to the Fiery Warpath.

Hunters wishing to travel to the Crystal Library location must obtain a Crystal Library Card from the mice found in this location.

# 👤 Absolute Acolyte Mouse

> **Entity**: Character | **Faction**: Rift Stalkers (Bristle Woods Rift)

> **Group / Faction**: Rift Stalkers (Bristle Woods Rift)  
> **Primary Habitat**: Bristle Woods Rift  
> **Vulnerable To**: Rift  
> **Favored Bait**: Runic String Cheese  
> **Reward Tier**: 1,000,000 Points | 300,000 Gold

## 📜 Lore & Persona

> "Phenomenal cosmic power bound only by the Bristle Woods Rift, these terrifying mice of immense influence and control over time are a mere whisker away from breaking free from their confinements. Entwined in endless strings of time, altered by previous attempts at escape, it is unknown if the Absolute Acolyte Mouse will be able to eventually break free or perhaps already has, but we must do everything in our power to prevent this from occurring in any timeline!"

# 👤 Acolyte Mouse

> **Entity**: Character | **Faction**: The Forgotten Mice

> **Group / Faction**: The Forgotten Mice  
> **Primary Habitat**: Acolyte Realm  
> **Vulnerable To**: Forgotten  
> **Favored Bait**: Runic Cheese  
> **Reward Tier**: 31,850 Points | 36,309 Gold

## 📜 Lore & Persona

> "Years ago, the Acolyte mice brought necromancy to the Kingdom. Their undead creations rose from the depths of the Catacombs, with the sole purpose of destroying Gnawnia. Hunters’ lore states that the first-ever MouseHunter devised a way to turn the spells of the Forgotten Book against the Acolytes and banish them to another realm of existence, somewhere between the dead and the living. Had it not been for Plankrun’s heroic efforts, the small village of Gnawnia may never have become the prosperous town it is today. Now that they have returned, the Acolyte mice are amassing their creations, preparing to achieve their dark destiny: the eradication of each and every MouseHunter!"

# 👤 Ascended Elder Mouse

> **Entity**: Character | **Faction**: Rift Stalkers (Furoma Rift)

> **Group / Faction**: Rift Stalkers (Furoma Rift)  
> **Primary Habitat**: Furoma Rift  
> **Vulnerable To**: Rift  
> **Favored Bait**: Ascended Cheese  
> **Reward Tier**: 400,000 Points | 80,000 Gold

## 📜 Lore & Persona

> "With lives nearing completion, their bodies have grown weak in their old age but their spirits have grown strong, so strong that they can barely be contained in any physical realm. Focused on finding "oneness" through menial but meaningful work, their training has come full circle, back to where students begin. Sweeping the grand floors of the Grand Pagoda, they find greater meaning, purpose, humility and spiritual wholeness through this act of cleanliness and self-sacrifice.<br>They may look hapless and powerless, but don't let that fool you... Striking one down will make them become more powerful than you can possibly imagine."

## 📜 Lore & Persona

> "Once, the three tribes, Nerg, Derr and Elub, were one, united under a ruler so cruel and merciless that the tribes-mice lived in constant fear of his whims. The Elders formulated a plan to banish Balack’s spirit to a remote cove near the Jungle of Dread, but he had other plans. He allowed the Elders to banish him, but he corrupted their enchantment along the way, pulling his attackers into the cove with him to be his servants for the rest of eternity."

# 👤 Cartographer

> **Entity**: Character

> Cartographers sell and repair maps. Because their skills are rare, buying or repairing a map can be quite an expensive process.

Cartographers are masters of patching damaged maps. Their rare skill takes a long time to learn and is often passed down from generation to generation. Although the hopes of finding routes to new hunting locations is exciting, the tedious nature of restoring maps makes hiring a cartographer rather expensive.

Hunters will find they need special Maps and Keys to unlock new regions and adventures as they travel the kingdom. Occasionally, a Cartographer's skill is required to repair damaged maps or obtain rare keys. In order to enlist a Cartographer's help, a hunter must provide the item they wish to have restored (dropped as loot) as well a payment in gold.

With the start of Season 3 of treasure hunting, Cartographers began offering Scroll Cases for area-specific Treasure Maps in exchange for Ancient Relic.

## History and Trivia

- 25 March 2014: Vacant Lot Cartographer was opened for hunters to purchase Rift Detector with Drained Rocket Pack, Exploded Lightshow, Inert Riftwood and 25,000 gold to access Gnawnia Rift.
- 29 July 2015: Cartographers no longer have wait times. Each map piece used to require a certain length of time for the Cartographer to restore.
- 29 July 2015: King's Gauntlet Floorplan is sold at Bazaar instead of Harbour.

# 👤 Charm Shoppe

> **Entity**: Character

Enhance your bait with magical charms that can boost the stats of your trap!
Using these charms along with your bait can give your trap boosted stats or special abilities.
Charms are consumed each time a piece of bait is used.

A Charm Shoppe is a shop which sells charms. Several regions include a permanent Charm Shoppe, and Events also tend to have a temporary Charm Shoppe. While the wording of the charm shoppe implies that charms are consumed on an encounter, there are some exceptions to the rule; read the "Consumed Upon" stat for a particular charm to see when it will be consumed.

## History and Trivia

- The Mountain Charm Shoppe was introduced on 12 January 2011 when Moustachio the Charmer returned to Gnawnia.
- On 25 January 2011, Charmbits became available to buy at the Mountain Charm Shoppe as Moustachio shared his secret to crafting Charms.
- The Crystal Library Charm Shoppe was introduced on 23 August 2011, fourteen days after the location release.
- The Haunted Terrortories Charm Shoppe was introduced on 19 October 2011 during the Halloween at the Haunted Terrortories event.
- The Festive Comet Charm Shoppe was introduced on 7 December 2011 during the Great Winter Hunt 2011 event.

# 👤 Cheese Shoppe

> **Entity**: Character

> Welcome to the Cheese Shoppe! Using better cheese attracts mice to your trap more often, so be sure to buy the best cheese you can afford, without exceeding the gold you earn from hunting. Want to save your gold and achieve the best attraction rate around? Buy SUPERlbrie+, and experience perks in attraction, crafting, and exclusive mice!

A Cheese Shoppe is a type of shop that offers various types of cheese for Hunters. Cheese is necessary for attracting mice to a trap setup..

# 👤 Deep Mouse

> **Entity**: Character | **Faction**: Icewing's Invasion (Misc)

> **Group / Faction**: Icewing's Invasion (Misc)  
> **Primary Habitat**: Iceberg  
> **Vulnerable To**: Hydro  
> **Favored Bait**: No Preference  
> **Reward Tier**: 142,550 Points | 24,525 Gold

## 📜 Lore & Persona

> "Finally solving the question as to how the Iceberg is propelled, the Deep Mouse lives well below the Iceberg, dragging it relentlessly towards the shores of Gnawnia.Only the most dedicated hunters will ever be able to encounter this monster, let alone defeat it!"

# 👤 Dojo Sensei

> **Entity**: Character | **Faction**: Followers of Furoma

> **Group / Faction**: Followers of Furoma  
> **Primary Habitat**: Pinnacle Chamber  
> **Vulnerable To**: Tactical  
> **Favored Bait**: Onyx Gorgonzola  
> **Reward Tier**: 28,665 Points | 34,500 Gold

## 📜 Lore & Persona

> "Rarely seen, these wise old mice instruct the Dojo Masters from the shadows, lest their presence be known to MouseHunters. Hunting these mice is not for the faint of heart -- their swift attacks can leave the courage of even the most steadfast hunter extremely crippled. Hunters who take on the challenge of catching a Dojo Sensei and succeed are held in the highest regard, for they have conquered the forces of the Furoma region."

## 🧀 Kebiasaan Umpan & Perilaku Berburu
### Cheese

The Dojo Sensei is attracted only to Onyx Gorgonzola.

# 👤 Dragon Mouse

> **Entity**: Character | **Faction**: Draconic Brood

> **Group / Faction**: Draconic Brood  
> **Primary Habitat**: Dracano  
> **Vulnerable To**: Draconic  
> **Favored Bait**: Inferno Havarti  
> **Reward Tier**: 74,200 Points | 39,940 Gold

## 📜 Lore & Persona

> "High above the summit of Dracano circles the terrible Dragon mouse, scourge of the Tribal Isles. To this date, no trap has withstood the Dragon's fiery breath, and all attempts to hunt it have reduced the most advanced traps to smoking debris. Legend has it that the Acolyte Mice held the key to controlling the Dragon, but now that they are trapped in another realm, the Dragon mouse has expanded its territory. The Tribal Isles need a brave MouseHunter to confront this menace, before it sets its sights on Gnawnia!"

## 💎 Rampasan Berharga (Loot Drops)
- **Drop Items**: Ancient RelicDragon's ChestDragon Ember

# 👤 Eclipse Mouse

> **Entity**: Character | **Faction**: Gauntlet Gladiators (Tier 8: The Eclipse)

> **Group / Faction**: Gauntlet Gladiators (Tier 8: The Eclipse)  
> **Primary Habitat**: King's Gauntlet  
> **Vulnerable To**: Forgotten  
> **Favored Bait**: Gauntlet Cheese Tier 8  
> **Reward Tier**: 379,000 Points | 300,000 Gold

## 📜 Lore & Persona

> "This mouse cares not for cheese. To say the Eclipse Mouse commands the forces of darkness would be to underestimate its power, for it commands the very fear of darkness, liquifying hunters’ souls with a constant barrage of nightmares. It also turns traps against their owners, sending knives, lasers and even giant squid sailing through the air after opponents. It has only been trapped once before, and after it reached the King’s gauntlet, the hunter disappeared. Good luck."

## 💎 Rampasan Berharga (Loot Drops)
- **Drop Items**: Ancient Relic

# 👤 Ful'Mina the Mountain Queen

> **Entity**: Character | **Faction**: Moussu Picchu Inhabitants (Storm Dragon)

> **Group / Faction**: Moussu Picchu Inhabitants (Storm Dragon)  
> **Primary Habitat**: Moussu Picchu  
> **Vulnerable To**: Draconic  
> **Favored Bait**: Dragonvine Cheese  
> **Reward Tier**: 120,000 Points | 30,000 Gold

## 📜 Lore & Persona

> "Resting high above Moussu Picchu among the clouds, Ful'Mina is the true queen of the mountain and ruler over the skies and storms. As the Moussu Picchu Inhabitants below battle endlessly for dominance of the weather, the resulting stalemate allows the queen to slumber for generations.<br>Once, long ago, she would appear high above the land anywhere a lightning cloud hovered, visiting the many realms of mice across Gnawnia, her tail smacking the ground like lightning as she plucked treasures with it to add to her hoard. Now, countless decades pass in between sightings of the Mountain Queen, so much so that her very existence has gone from folklore, to legend, to mere myth...<br>But now, MouseHunters from the Kingdom of Gnawnia have found their way through the mountain pass, and their presence has brought a shift to the power struggle in these ruins, as they always do. Hunters have begun to harness the powers of both the Wind Wanderer and Rain Roamer tribes of mice in the area, ironically bringing unity between the two after endless centuries of feuding.<br>As the winds grow stronger, the rains fall heavier, and the storms begin to mix and clash, great bone-shaking growls can be heard from above the thickest of clouds, where the queen is said to reside. Is this thunder? Or is it the great Mountain Queen being rudely awakened from her slumber? Slowly but surely, disturbed by the intensifying battle in the lands below and the low rumble of impending thunderstorms in the clouds upon which she rests, she begins to rouse from her deep sleep...<br>Soon, and without warning, Ful'Mina, the Mountain Queen, will descend upon the lands with great fury to bring order to the chaos through the destructive force of her indomitable lightning storms."

This tiny mouse courses with energy, presumed to be what radiates throughout the Fort Rox mice, causing all of the unique transformations.<br>Seemingly at peace and unaware of her surroundings, she is in a deep and powerful trance, emitting waves of bright, blinding light to supply her followers with their great strength and abilities.<br>Nothing can break her trance, save for the alluring source of sunlight from Sunrise Cheese..."

# 👤 Icewing

> **Entity**: Character | **Faction**: Icewing's Invasion (Misc)

> **Group / Faction**: Icewing's Invasion (Misc)  
> **Primary Habitat**: Iceberg  
> **Vulnerable To**: Hydro  
> **Favored Bait**: No Preference  
> **Reward Tier**: 51,250 Points | 11,295 Gold

## 📜 Lore & Persona

> "Legends tell of an ancient, hateful mouse, a child of wrath and ice, spoken about only in hushed tones around campfires to scare children and the weak-hearted. But this mouse is no fairy tale, and has a long and dark history with the Kingdom of Gnawnia.<br>Long ago, a powerful band of evil mice descended yearly upon Gnawnia in fearsome raids, stealing cheese and terrifying everyone. Icewing herself lead many a raid, and was next in line for rulership when the jealous chieftans banded together and cast her out, fearful that with her incredible power and cruelty, she would have done the same to them.<br>Over the years since, she has raised an army from the mice who remained loyal to her, and turned her sights to the south. Determined to prove that she can accomplish more without her traitorous clan holding her back, she intends to invade Gnawnia and see every mouse there swear fealty to her as their Queen. But first, she must wipe out the pesky humans who seem to get in the way of everything..."

# 👤 King

> **Entity**: Character

> "King" redirects here. For other uses, see King (disambiguation).

The King of Gnawnia has called brave mouse hunters to his kingdom to fight the mice that are destroying his lands. It is he that pays rewards to hunters. He also has the power to increase the title of a hunter. The King's name is currently a mystery, although speculation exists that his name has been determined by MouseHunt developers. A contest held in the Summer of 2008 garnered hundreds of guesses from players. When the contest ended, it was revealed by the developers that the King's name had not yet been correctly guessed.

The King knows how bad the mouse problem is in Gnawnia from personal experience. On 10 September 2008, the King's Crown was stolen by a Master Burglar Mouse. The Master Burglar Mouse was later caught by a lucky hunter, resulting in the greatest single prize awarded in MouseHunt to date.

When MouseHunt is added to Facebook profile tab (a feature which has since been disabled), the background image features the King as well as the Master Burglar mouse.

The King is the author of the Sandtail Call to Arms.

# 👤 Mythweaver

> **Entity**: Character | **Faction**: Storytellers (Folklore Masterminds)

> **Group / Faction**: Storytellers (Folklore Masterminds)  
> **Primary Habitat**: Table of Contents  
> **Vulnerable To**: Forgotten  
> **Favored Bait**: Final Draft Derby Cheese  
> **Reward Tier**: 1,000,000 Points | 70,000 Gold

## 📜 Lore & Persona

> "Many a cautionary tale has been written about the dangers of hubris but few are as poignant or consequential as the one being penned by the Mythweaver.<br>This once meek and meager mouse began its story as a simple Bookborn willed into existence by the maniacal Zurreal the Eternal. There was something unique about this particular manifestation however and it caused Zurreal to take special notice. This Bookborn exhibited more intelligence, intuition, and understanding than the rest of its kind and so Zurreal decided to share small fragments of his immense knowledge with this curious creature. As the Bookborn consumed more knowledge, its abilities began to grow and so too did its usefulness. Zurreal recognized an opportunity to mold and shape this exceptional creation into a powerful assistant capable of expediting his plans to conquer humans and mice alike.<br>Unbeknownst to Zurreal, this creature was consuming knowledge at an unimaginable rate and before long, its intelligence and understanding had begun to surpass even its master's. This nameless creation eventually sought to have an identity of its own and, having developed a particular fascination with the countless volumes of folklore contained in the Crystal Library, began calling itself the Mythweaver. The Mythweaver began to recognize that he was merely a servant to an insane and tyrannical leader, a mere cog in a broken machine. And with that profound realization, this ethereal creature transformed into a unique and extraordinarily powerful mouse! On that day, the Mythweaver vowed to turn against his creator and become a true leader of mice; dedicated not only to their survival but to their supremacy in the land of Gnawnia!<br>So the Mythweaver scoured every inch of the great library in search of a means by which he could conquer the kingdom on behalf of his kind and one day he found what he had been searching for. Hidden inside a forgotten book on a forgotten shelf, the Mythweaver discovered a single page that Zurreal had missed all these years. This enchanted page was written by Zugzwang himself and on it he learned of a secret place of unprecedented power: the Folklore Forest!<br>He learned that deep in the Folklore Forest there exists a magical Book of Lore which contains the entire history of Gnawnia scribbled throughout its pages. What is special about this book however, is that if the words on these pages are changed then so too will history itself be changed. And thus began the Mythweaver's quest to rewrite history by writing the mice as the glorious champions and the humans as the vanquished foes!"

# 👤 Plankrun

> **Entity**: Character

The first ever Mouse Hunter; Plankrun was commissioned by the King to investigate the strange behaviors of the Mice appearing in the region of Gnawnia. His fate is, as of yet, unknown. However, pages torn from his journal have been found across the region, detailing his brave escapades. The page read by the Scribe Mouse mentions that he was known as Sir Plankrun.

# 👤 Retired Minotaur Mouse

> **Entity**: Character | **Faction**: Citizens of Zokor (Hidden Remnant)

> **Group / Faction**: Citizens of Zokor (Hidden Remnant)  
> **Primary Habitat**: Zokor  
> **Vulnerable To**: Forgotten  
> **Favored Bait**: None  
> **Reward Tier**: 1,000,000 Points | 1,000,000 Gold

## 📜 Lore & Persona

> "Once young and lively, this minotaur loved racing through the hallways of the Labyrinth, chasing down hunters and mice alike, howling and bellowing with delight as they scurried at the mere sound of his hooves on the cobbled floors. But now, it seems he has run his last lap of the maze, and has settled down into cozy end-life routines. Donning his fuzzy slippers in his favourite easy chair (which is a giant sack of gold), this retired beast has had his pension paid out in full and has relocated to his secret inner chamber to enjoy his retirement in peace and quiet.<br>The same shenanigans that used to bring him joy now only cause him grief, and he can be seen shaking his fist from atop his tower at the other mice hustling and bustling in the city. All that noise, all that racket! What a grumpy old grump this once playful beast has become...<br>But even in his twilight and seemingly endless misery, he still manages to let a small grin spread across his lips whenever he causes a mouse to jump in fear at the sound of his snort or the clipping of his hooves.<br>No one has broken into his private chambers and lived to tell the tale. Rumor has it that he stores many great and valuable items on opulent displays. Perhaps a resourceful hunter can find a way in and nab one of these rare treasures before being caught!"

# 👤 Ronza

> **Entity**: Character

Ronza is a traveling merchant. The king allows her to sell exotic goods from her traveling shoppe, an airship. When she enters a region her location is an area available to hunters. Not much is known about her, though rumors are that she comes back on special occasions such as giveaways.

Nobody knows when (or if) she's coming back, what she will be selling, or how long she will stay.

# 👤 Trapsmith

> **Entity**: Character

> Trapsmiths sell weapons and bases that you can use to upgrade your trap's power, power bonus, luck, and attraction bonus. Power, power bonus and luck help you catch mice more often, and attraction bonus boosts your ability to attract mice. For safety reasons, Trapsmiths require you to meet strict points requirements in order to purchase higher-level traps. Visit other trapsmiths around the Kingdom to find new and more powerful weapons and bases.

A Trapsmith is a shop found in many locations. They are the places in MouseHunt for hunters to purchase new non-crafted weapons, bases and skins.

### Ronza's Traveling Shoppe Trapsmith

At Ronza's Traveling Shoppe, Ronza, the traveling merchant, appears on certain occasions, selling rare stock from her unknown homeland. On most of her visits, her trapsmith has offered rare, limited edition trap components. Note that the stock varies with each visit, and only items currently being sold can be refunded. ## History and Trivia

On 29 September 2010, the Meadow quit selling the Mouse Rocketine and NVMRC Forcefield Trap.

With the introduction of MouseHunt 3.0, several new trapsmiths were added, and existing shops changed prices and lineups for some consistency. In particular, the trapsmith formerly at the Lagoon relocated to the Great Gnarled Tree.

Before MouseHunt 3.0, Larry's description of a Trapsmith was:
Trapsmiths sell the tools of the MouseHunter trade. They are experts in creating powerful weapons and the bases required to mount them upon. Trapsmiths are most often retired MouseHunters who follow a line of tradition and therefore insist that a hunter has an appropriate level of experience before they will sell them a trap component.

Trapsmiths set up shops all around the world - as hunters travel to new regions and locations they will be able to buy from the unique stock of each shop.

# Aura

## Overview

An Aura is a trap bonus that is earned by completing certain tasks within the game. Each Aura is represented by an image in the upper left of the trap image on the Hunter's Camp and Profile pages.

Auras can provide improved trap stats additional effects.

The duration time of the Aura's stacks and the aura's time will be extended each time the aura is awarded until its maximum time, if any, is reached.

# ⚙️ Crafting

> **Entity**: Mechanic

> **Hukum Dunia / Mekanik Cerita**: Crafting

## 📜 Konsep Lore & Aturan Permainan

# Crafting

Crafting is an integral part of MouseHunt, especially as players advance along the ranks. Once players advance to Initiate, the crafting tab will be accessible to them. Crafting allows players to put together different items that they have collected throughout the game. The result of crafting can be traps, cheeses, and other crafting items.

The in-game Crafting section of the Inventory tab is divided into three sub-sections: Recipe Book, Crafting Table, and Hunter's Hammer.

## Recipe Book

By switching to the Recipe Book sub-tab, a hunter can find a particular recipe that they have unlocked, and select how many multiples of that recipe to craft at once. All recipes can be learned by crafting with the correct raw ingredients. Additionally, many recipes can be learned, even without a first crafting, by completing particular tasks. For a full list of recipes that can be learned, see Recipe Tasks.

The recipe book does not list event crafting done via special pages, such as the initial construction of the Nannybot during MouseHunt Birthday II, or toys built during the Toy Drive of the Great Winter Hunt 2011.

Twenty-five of these recipes are also tracked via the Book of Living Recipes in the Heads-up Display of the Living Garden and related areas.

## Crafting Table

The Crafting Table sub-tab lets a hunter experiment with new recipes without first unlocking them from Recipe Tasks.

### Crafting Items

Crafting items are the components or ingredients required in order to successfully create a crafted item. The complete list of all items that can be used in crafting can be found under Crafting Items. Information is given on the source as to where players can acquire individual items, as well as the crafted product(s) it is used in.

### Crafting Slots

Crafting slots are what allow you to create certain cheeses and other items. Each ingredient in a recipe requires the use of a slot (regardless of the quantity of that ingredient). As you progress in rank, you will gain more slots for crafting, which allows you to craft items requiring more ingredients. Additionally, while many formulas only require 2 or 3 slots to craft, the ingredients are not available for lower ranks. Every rank will always be able to safely craft the items of the lower ranks. Therefore a Master will be able to craft items available to Journeymen, Initiates and Apprentices.

| Rank | Total Slots |
| --- | --- |
| Initiate | 2 |
| Journeyman | 3 |
| Master | 4 |
| Grandmaster | 5 |
| Legendary | 6 |
| Hero | 7 |
| Knight | 8 |
| Lord/Lady | 9 |
| Baron/Baroness | 10 |
| Count/Countess | 11 |
| Duke/Duchess | 12 |
| Grand Duke/Grand Duchess | 12 |
| Archduke/ArchDuchess | 12 |
| Viceroy | 12 |
| Elder | 13 |
| Sage | 14 |
| Fabled | 15 |

When crafting a new recipe for the first time, the player is given an opportunity to share an Attraction Charm with friends, and the result of the crafting appears on the Hunter's Journal.

Before MouseHunt updated to Version 3.0 on 8 June 2010, the last slot of each rank was a Red Slot. If you used the correct recipe, and used the Red Slot, you had chance of losing all of your ingredients that you tried to use and not being successful in creating the new item. Otherwise, crafting works exactly the same now as it did before.

### Unknown Recipes

When a new recipe is introduced and the ingredients are unknown, it is possible to determine the correct ingredients through trial and error. When you use the correct type of materials but in wrong quantities, you get a message saying, "Almost there The right parts are used but the quantities aren't correct," instead of the usual "Huh? Nothing seems to quite fit together."

If the quantities are right but the item cannot be constructed because the hunter has already reached the maximum inventory count for that item, the message states "Sorry Your inventory can not currently hold this item." For example, the S.S. Huntington III map piece is a capped inventory item, meaning it is not possible to craft both the Christened Ship and S.S. Huntington III recipes (however, both recipes can be learned by completing the recipe task of catching a Hydra mouse).

## Hunter's Hammer

This section manages items that can be smashed for creating further items for crafting. The complete list of smashable items can be found under the Hunter's Hammer page. The Hunter's Hammer sub-tab is the only crafting ability available to hunters below Initiate rank.
